data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Tiek chenro mokwongo e Satisfactory ′s Server Manager kendo dhi nyime tiyo gi -NewConsole.
Dwok piny kae. Synix oro chikno, osomo tokeni manyienno, onene, kendo orite maber. Onge ng'ato ang'ata ma nyalo ndiko kata pimo gimoro.

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Chakruok Machuok 1. Ket nying tuke kod namba mar Steam server AppID. 2. Ket yo ma inyalo tiyoe gi server kaluwore gi folda mar server moseket. 3. Ket mana ndiko mar chik ma biro bang' gima inyalo tiyoe. Ti gi weche moler piny kae kama Synix nyaka ketie chenro mar ng'ato. 4. Yier kaka tugono biro yudo fom mar chano. Yo ma itiyogo e timo kamano dwaro ni ibed gi chenro mar tich maber, to ok ranyisi moro matin. 5. Yier Validate & Preview. Rieyo chandruok moro amora monyis kapok ichoko pesa. 6. Waruru, losuru kendo Synix, timuru nonro mitimo e yo machuok, kae to temuru keto mise/chakruok/chungo/temo chiko tuke.
SULA MA DWONGO • Nying ' tuke: nying' ma jogo ma tiyo kode neno e Synix. • Nyukta mar ID: nyukta matindo tindo kende; Synix nolose kaluwore gi nying tuke. • Steam AppID: AppID mar server mochiw, to ok kinde duto AppID mar game client. • Kaka itiyo gi SteamCMD: kinde mang'eny onge gimoro amora. Loso tuke mag GoldSrc AppID 90 kitiyo gi fom mar "90 mod folder", kaka "90 mod cstrike". Synix oyie mana gi fom mar ritruokni. • Inyalo tiye: kuom ranyisi Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Ok oriw folda mar keto gik moko. • Ports: ports mag tuke kod penjo ma ok kare. • Map kod yore mag tuke: ket nengo achiel sie mar tuke e moro ka moro kuom yorego. Mago nyalo pong'o yiero ma itimo sama ichano kata iloso server.
THOKO MAG WACHIEGO Kik idonj e sandukno. Ket tong' mag tuke kaka weche mapile kendo ket tong' mana ne nengo ma Synix chiko. Ranyisi: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
NG'OTH MA WECHE MOKWONJO [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Ket {rcon} e sanduge mag goyo misonari kama chik mar RCON en mar yiero. E weche mag RCON, ti gi: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Ranyisi mar RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
KIT NG'ATO MODHIWO • Pok onyis ni kare: Synix ok ti gi fom mar chano gik moko. • Game chako timo kamano bang' chakruok: ti gi chenro mar loso kendo loso gik moko e yo maber. • Synix loso modno kotiyo gi template: Synix keto chenro duto kapok ochako. • Golo mana weche mag goyo mbaka: ok ochuno ni nyaka iti gi chenro mar goyo mbaka.
TEMPLOT MAG WECHE MA Gichiko {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} ndiko nengo mar adiera mar wach ka wach sirkal nitie kod nengo mar miriambo sama wach sirkal onge. Ti gi Add configuration files sama server dwaro weche mokalo achiel. Yier moro ka moro kuom fail molony, kae to ilos kama oseketie e tabulano mondo yo obed motudore gi folda mar server. Synix tiyo gi weche duto moler kanyachiel.
DHANO MACHON MA JATIM OSABIYO Ket yo achiel mar rito kodhi e moro ka moro kuom yorego, kopim gi folda mar server moseloso. Duto ma dwarore mondo okony ng'ato chako tiyo gi kompyuta nyaka sani; gik moko duto ma ok ochuno ni idwar ka iyudogi, to kik igeng'o tijni. Kapo ni weche ma idwaro yudore e tuke mapile, ler weche duto ma jatichno nyalo timo e bwo weche mag Setiyo kodgi. Synix ok nyal golo, kata weyo bedo e bwo ratiro mar bedo jaodgi, kata pogo kendo weche molos gi joluo. Folda mar data ma oko en nying folda ma Synix nyalo manyo e bwo folda mar Documents. Weye obed ma onge gimoro amora kapo ni otiyo gi kompyuta e ndiko weche manie iye.
Siem Mokwongo Kendo Loso Ranyisi Nyis ni ineno siemno sama idwaro tieko tijni kapok ichako tiyo kode. Ndik ane weche duto ma ng'ato nyalo tiyogo e loso tuke. URL mar icon en mar yiero kendo nyaka iti gi HTTPS. Synix dok i icon ma kitiyo kwede me cobo tic pa server ka tye ma pe iye.
RECHONDO MA MUMA NITIE Chak weche manyien kod template e revision 1. Med lokruok mar lero tiend weche sama ler mar tuke olokore. Med lokruok mar template mana ka lokruoge ma itimo e chano chenro. Synix otamore ndiko weche moko maok ochan kendo orito weche modok korka timo dongruok.
GIMA INYALO TIMO Bang ' TEGO Yie mondo Steam oketh kinde ma itiyogo mana bang' neno ni server dwaro ni itim kamano. Dwarore ni obed folda moro matin ei masindno. Synix ndiko mana DLL adek mag Steam ma ne oket.
Gik Madwarore Kuom Kinde Ket chenro mar piny mogik RAM mondo obed 0 ka ok ochuno ni nyaka ng'ato otim kamano. Nonro mag masinde kod mag Windows nyiso gik ma ok ochuno kapok iketo kendo geng'o ka ichako tiyo gi masindno e yo maok ni kare; ok gilok tong' mar Windows. Yier .NET Framework kata Visual C++ runtime mana ka gik ma ochuno e tuke nyiso mano. Synix nono register mar Windows to ok ogol kata golo gik mochuno. Hyper-V dwaro Windows Professional kata mokalo kanyo, omiyo yiero Hyper-V bende yiero dwaro mar Windows.
KIT NG'ATO MODHIWO Ti gi chenro mar timo nonro e weche mag server. (b) tiyo gi masinde mamoko ma nyalo miyo ng'ato oyud thuolo mar tiyo gi masindno e yo maber. ok nyal timo nonro e wi penjo. Miye teko mar bedo gi jarit ma nenore maber mar tuke ma jarit sirkande mag kompyuta nyaka bed ni tiyo. Mano ok nyal geng'o paro ma ng'ato nigo e wi yore duto mag konyruok mana kuom wachni kende. Oting'o weche mag .exe, .bat, kod .cmd kende. Miye thuolo mar oro gik moko oko mana ka ng'ato nigi nyalo mar loso kod tiyo gi gik moko e yo makare maok otudore gi Synix. Weche ma ne owachgo nyiso ni jogo oikore, bang' ka osetim nonro makende mar bedo moikore. Puothego yiero timbe mag Synix modak e kindgi kendo ok ginyal tiyo gi script kata plugins.
NG'ENO MA NYASAYE Ket yorego motudore gi folda mar server moseket. Ti gi * mar yo achiel kata nying fail kod ** mar folda motwe. Joluo moketi e migepego gin {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, kod {QueryPort}. Ranyisi: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix manyo yoregi mana ka ng'ato okwayo mondo oyaw gocho manyien mar tuke.

data.value: Tim lokruok mondo ine nying' kod kuonde ma inyalo yudoe weche ma iserito. Yier kata ndik nying jatuo kae to inon gima itimo. Chikego dwaro ni obed gi server ma tiyo kod konzo mar tich. Bedrock ok riw lwedo chike mag kwedo Java.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Lok server.properties kod mod/plugin. Weche ma Synix tiyogo inyalo ti gi sama okan server.properties. Nying molos / MOTD opogore gi nying piny ma oket e ndikoni. Refresh duoko lokruok mag konigruok mag oko ka pod ochung'.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Save loso kopi mag resruok. Lokruoge ma ne otim e dho wath, piny, kodhi, yore mag tuke, tong' mar jatuo, koda chenro mag chiko Minecraft makonyo bende miyo Synix bedo manyien. JSON, XML, kod YAML ibiro non kapok okan; fom mamoko dwaro ni otimnegi lokruok e yo matut. Ket weche migeno obed maling'ling'.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Golo Java kata Bedrock world ZIP e folda manyien, kae to yier mondo iti kode. Piny masani ok nyal lokore. Gocho mag Muma ok lokre. Tiyo gi lokruok ok nyal miyo ng'ato obed gi nyalo mar timo gik moko e yo maber kata marach, kendo ok nyal miyo ng'ato obed gi nyalo mar timo gik moko e yo maber. Mokwongo, duog ane malo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Non ane weche mag JAR kod gik ma otenore kuom JAR, ti gi weche mag add-on mopogore opogore, kata non pak mar server duto. Ti gi weche molos e bugno. Nonro ma itimo kuom weche motudore gi kodhino konyo ahinya kendo ok onyis ni kodhino nigi rit kata ni mod duto biro tiyo maber.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Buge duto moting'o weche mokor oriwo folda mar server, piny, weche momedore, kod chenro. Kwong igeng' server. Tem neno kabe itimo kamano kapok idok e tich. Duoko kuonde ma okethore e kar fail mag server; Olembego nyiso ni gik moko duto ok nikare, to ok ni nitie chandruok moro mosekalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Lokruok moro amora mitimo e weche moting'o weche ma ne ok ong'ere chon. Yier lokruok ma itimo kata ma ok itimo mondo iyudgo. Mokwongo, nyaka iketh lokruok manyien mosetimore. Fichego ma ne oloki gi oko kaachiel gi piny ma ne owilgo bende ritgi. Bed gi kar dak moromo mondo ikony ji otim dongruok e tij lendo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Tem manyo chandruoge mapile e weche mag server kod ripode mag masira. Gik ma ne giyudo ne gin weche ma nyiso gima ne otimore, to ok gik ma ne otimore. process CPU/RAM ok en Minecraft TPS/MSPT; tiyo gi masinde ma nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi paro mowinjore sama onyiso ni otiyo gi masindego e yo maber.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: Ere kaka inyalo geng'o serverni odonj e Synix?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: Be inyalo chako kendo tiyo gi Synix?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Ere kaka inyalo keto weche mag tuke, loader, kod gedo kitiyo gi gik ma gipuonjore? Mano nyalo miyo igol Java kendo iti gi masindno mar Forge/NeoForge. Dhok mar server iketo mokwongo; Fichego ma ne odonjne chon, inyalo tigo e loso gik moko. Piny kod gik mamoko bende oserito. Tim backups duto kapok iloko weche mag tuke. Ne ok ochak tiyo gi server mar tuke.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Be ibiro oro chik mar joluo moyier? Ng'ato nyalo bedo gi ratiro mar chiko weche e wi server mar tuke.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Be ibiro tiyo gi piny ma iyiero e chako? Piny masani siko e disk. Yier mana piny ma luwore gi loko mar serverni, version, kod mods.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Ere kaka inyalo ng'ado mar kelo pak mar server ma igeno? Pack mar Modrinth nyalo golo fail molos gi weche mowuok e fuonde mag HTTPS moyiego. Mod kod script mag tuke tiyo gi kodhi ei server mar tuke. Layout, hash, kod timo nonro e wi antivirus ok nyal miyo ng'ato obed ma onge hinyruok. Non lokruok duto kapok itiyogo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Chenro mar nono gik moko osomogi maok ochiko kod mod. Weche moting'o weche mopogore opogore, weche moting'o weche motudore gi wechego, koda moko kuom weche moting'o weche machon nyaka tim nonro mar lwedo. Nonro ma kamago ok nyis ni malware onge.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Skipped
data.value: Ok ok: {0}

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Non kama itime konyruokno kod kar dak.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Ere kaka inyalo loso kar dak mar server ma ne oweyo?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Ere kaka inyalo duoko gik moko duto ma ne idwaro? Files manie server biro lokore. Tim nonro e kalatese ma isomoni kae to iket weche duto ma idwaro kapok idhi nyime.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Yud weche machon mag lokruogni. Files momed gi lokruogno ibiro gol mana ka ok oloki. Duto ma ne otimnegi lokruoge moko, ne ok nyal geng'o weche odwok. Gimaduong' madwarore en timo backups mondo oketh lokruok moro amora mitimo bang' chako game machielo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Onge ranyisi moro amora ma yudore e buge machon. Mano ok en nonro mar thieth. Ti gi ranyisi mar Preparedness mondo ine kabe nitie ketho mokwongo machiegni gi kinde ma ne okethoreno.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Nonro kapok itimo: {0} manyien • {1} oloki • {2} ogol oko. Weche machon-go okan mondo odwokgi. Ok ochak tiyo gi server moro amora.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Ok ochuno ni ng'ato obed gi masindno kata kik ogol masindno. Tim nonro e yo manyien e wi loko/loso kendo tem kendo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Mago gin weche ma ok nyal geng'o weche duto manie iye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Weche mag dwoko piny onge kata ok winjre. Ket folda mar resruok kendo iti gi backup ma osenenore chuth.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Gimoro amora ma ne itimo chon dwaro ni ochak oduogi. Open Change Recovery kendo ilerne kapok itimo lokruok machielo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Fichni oselokore chakre nonro mosetim kata chakre timno. Non kendo kendo. Onge lokruok moro amora ma ok otudore gi tijno ma ibiro ndik malo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Yo ma ng'ato nyalo wuoyogo kod yo mowuoyogo ok en gima ni kare, ok ong'ere malong'o, kata onge ng'at manyalo riwe lwedo. Yier pak mar server kata archive mar piny.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Pinyni en piny ma ji ng'iewoe gik moko. Lokri idhi e piny machielo kapok iweye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Folda mar pinyno nitie. Yier nying folda manyien; Kata kamano, piny masani ok nyal kethi nikech ouso.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Yier archive moting'o piny achiel gi level.dat. Kata kamano, kar timo kamano, gikonyo e rito weche mag tich.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Pinyni ok luwre gi weche mag server, kata onge kuonde minyalo yudoe kuonde mitimoe nonro. Piny mag Java kod Bedrock ok olokre.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Ti gi nying folda mar piny moting'o weche makare, maonge yo kata nying Windows. Kuom piny ma ne idhi gologo, ti gi barupe, kwan, kuonde moketi, kata weche moting'o weche.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Tijni itiyogo ne mod/plugins mag Java server. Ti gi chenro mar tich mar Bedrock; JAR mag Java ok nyal tiyo gi Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Ne ok oyud gimoro amora ma ne yudore e server. Modpack ok kel script mag lawe, fail mag jokanyo, seche mag ringo, piny, kod kuonde ma sirkande mag root tiyogo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Kit weche manie iye ok luwre gi program moyier mar server. Mods dwaro mod loader mowinjore; Plugins mag Bukkit/Paper onego obed gi thuolo mar tiyo gi plugin.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Mani en gaset mar CurseForge, to ok gaset mar server. Download ZIP server mar jandiko ma oting'o modi kod gik molos; Weche ma ok yudore ok nyal wilgo aling' ling'.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Minecraft version mar paket kod loader/build nyaka luwre gi serverni. Mokwongo, yier kendo iti gi sa ma idwaro tiyogo. Masinde ma ok oting'o gik mochido ok nyal tieki.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Dwaro mar golo kata tiyo gi yo machielo ok en mar ng'ato owuon HTTPS Wachno en adier. Kar mano, ti gi adres mar ZIP mar jandiko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Ficha ma ne ogol ne ok luwore gi okang' ma ne olandgo kata hash mar SHA-512. Onge gimoro amora ma ne oket.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Wach mar Minecraft ma Synix tiyogo ok nyal tiyo kata ok winjre. Tem neno kuonde ma idhiye, tong ' mar jatuwo, yore mag tuke, kod gik ma inyalo chiko kapok ichoko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: Synix ne ok nyal kano weche ma ne oseloki e server. Ne ok oyie gi tijno; Fichego ne orito kuonde ma ne dwarore.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Synix's Minecraft tudruok mar sirkal nyaka dhi nyime e localhost. Kik inyis Intanet kama itiyogo e timo nonro.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: Yore ma oketgo oketo mar tiyo gi Synix. Yier dho wath machielo kapok ichoko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Yier gima idwaro timo kod nying' mar jagol-tugo. Giko mar Java ok en chik mar Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Server ne ok ochako. Tem ane nono gik ma timore e dashboard kod gik ma timore e dashboard kapok itimo tembego kendo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: Ne ok nyal somo weche duto. Non fwenyno kod weche ma jandiko wacho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Ji mang'eny manie riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova e piny mangima nyiso ni gin Joneno. Non kendo gol kopi mar Muma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: JARni wacho ni en mar jorit kende. Kik iket kode e server moro.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: Medo mar JAR ok luwre gi loader/software moyier.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Dwaro mar bedo ng'at ma ok nyal yudo weche manie meta data ma osekan: {0}. Tem neno kabe nitie gimoro ma idwaro timo kata ok idwar.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyVersion
data.value: Ng'ato ka ng'ato {0} dwaro {1}; Dhok ma ne onono en {2}.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Ng'ado mar ng'eyo kaka {0} chal: {1} dwarore, {2} osekan. Ok ong'ere chuth ni kwan/dwoko ma kamano en mane.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: Bugno nyiso ni Java/class-version ok owinjore. Ti gi weche mag Java madwarore kuom server moyier kod mod loader.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Ripot nyiso ni Java ne ok nyal pogo weche moromo. Non ane kama RAM yudoree, kwan mar server, kod kabe server mamoko tiyo kode.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Bugno wuoyo kuom gik ma dwarore mondo ng'ato obed gi winjruok maber gi nyawadgi. Non ane kethruok mokwongo mar loader, kae to inon mod, dependency, game version, kod loader build.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Ripot nyiso ni nitie dho wath ma sani itiyogo. Non yore mamoko mag tiyo kod kuonde ma sirkandego oting'o; kik ichak tiyo gi kuonde ma ok otudore gi ohinga mar lweny.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: Od bura dwaro ni Minecraft EULA oyie. Som kendo iyie gi puonjno sama itimo chenro mar chako tich.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Ripot nyiso ni ng'ato ok dhi maber kata ok odhi maber. Non weche mag CPU load, world generation, entities, kod mods. Nyalo bedo ni RAM kende ok nyal tieko wachno.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Ketho mar mixin kinde mang'eny kelo pogruok e kind mod kod loader. Non ane gima nokelo masira mar ndara kod weche madwarore mondo okonygi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: Riwruok mar weche mag pinyno nyiso ni weche ma ne osomogo ne ok kare. Geng'o server kendo iket weche ma sani nitie kapok itimo backup.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Mapiyo bang'e, ne ok oket chenro mar tiyo tijno. Ti gi masinde duto mag kony mondo ichak idwokogi; Synix ok nyal ng'eyo gima ne otimoreno.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Sa mar tiyo ma iseketo ok luwre gi dwaro mar gocho, version, loader, kata Java. Open Minecraft Control Center kendo iti gi Apply Runtime kapok ichako.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.IncludeOptional
data.value: Ti gi mods mag server

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldFilter
data.value: Piny duto (*.zip)|*.zip

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackFilter
data.value: Minecraft pak mar server (*.zip;*.mrpack)|*.zip;*.mrpack

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.InvalidValue
data.value: Wach mar {0} ok en adier. Lok chenrono kapok ichoko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Empty
data.value: Onge gik monego onyis. Tim lokruok bang ' medo weche kata loko chenro mar serverni.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.State.Superseded
data.value: Owil gi loko mar backup

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilitySummary
data.value: {0} add-ons ne ofweny • nonro mar {1} ma onego onon. Chenrono ok lok weche.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityAddOns
data.value: Onge weche momedore ma ne oyud e folda mar mods kata plugins ma tiyo gi serverni.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityFindings
data.value: Nonro ma ne otim ne ok onyiso ni nitie chandruok moro amora. Mano ok nyis ni mod kata plugin duto biro tiyo kanyachiel.

data.name: AsaPackages.Button.Read
data.value: Som Mod Package

data.name: AsaPackages.Title
data.value: Som ASA mod package

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Yier ASA Windows-server ZIP ma isegolo kata folda ma iseyudo. Synix yudo mod descriptors ei pakni ma bor, mopong'o, kata ma nigi mode mang'eny kendo iko ID mag CurseForge mondo onon. Files mag ZIP ok olok kata ket. ASA golo kendo ndiko chenro mar server ma jatendno tiyogo sani sama ichako tiyo gi serverno; Mano ok nyis ni ineno weche manie ZIP.

data.name: AsaPackages.Source
data.value: Soko mar mod

data.name: AsaPackages.Id
data.value: Mod ID

data.name: AsaPackages.Descriptor
data.value: Kido mar jondiko

data.name: AsaPackages.Choose
data.value: Yier zip kata folda midwaro nono. Onge kuonde mitimoe lokruok kata fail ma biro lokore kapok inono kendo ireso mod ID e yo mopogore.

data.name: AsaPackages.Trust
data.value: Riwruok mar data ok nyal gen. Ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi program moro marach ok en timo nonro mar program moro marach, kata ng'eyo ni ng'atno en jandiko.

data.name: AsaPackages.Review
data.value: Non ane ID mag Mod

data.name: AsaPackages.Reading
data.value: Somo weche moting'o data. Onge kod moro amora mar mod mitimo.

data.name: AsaPackages.Found
data.value: {0} mods ong'ere; {1} yudo weche manyien. Nyukta mag ng'ato ma nitie sani rito chikgi. Non ane weche duto kapok ichoko.

data.name: AsaPackages.Timeout
data.value: Nonro mar paket ne ogol kata nokawo kinde malach ahinya. Yier folda matin mar paket kae to item kendo.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Source
data.value: Yier ARK server mod ZIP kata folda mod ma ibiro golo. Japuonjni ok ti gi fom mamoko mag archive.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Limit
data.value: Giko mar gasedno oloyo tong' mag japuonj mar metadata. Yier folda matin kata ZIP ma nigi weche malero mod mag 100 kende.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Gasedno oting'o yore ma ok ni kare, tudruok, yore ma ok kare, fail mopogore opogore, kata folda mang'eny ahinya. Onge gima ne olokore.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Descriptor
data.value: Ne ok onwang'o gimoro amora ma ne nyalo lero weche mag .uplugin mod. Yier mod ZIP kata folda mowuok kuome; Mokwongo, onego ogol gik moko duto ma ne okan chon.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Metadata
data.value: Mod descriptor ok en gima owinjore, kendo onge kiawa ni en JSON. Onge gima ne olokore.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Game
data.value: Ng'ato ok nyal fwenyo gimoro ARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge tich. Synix ok nyal ng'eyo ni en ang'o ma ne dhi timore e tuke kata ni en ng'a ma ne dhi bedo modich kode.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Id
data.value: Weche moler ok nyal tiyo gi gimoro achiel CurseForge ID mar chenro (cf_ugcID). Ti gi Mod IDs kod ID ma yudore e ite mar CurseForge mar jandiko.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.ServerBuild
data.value: Mod moro onge gi paket mar WindowsServer ma ong'ere kata onge fail mar .ucas/.utoc ma chalre kode. Yier download mar Windows-server, to ok gedo mar client.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.DuplicateMod
data.value: Olembego oting'o weche mang'eny ma nyiso ni ng'ato en ng'at machalo nade. Yier achiel kuom modgo kae to item kendo.

data.name: AsePackages.Title
data.value: Som ASE mod package

data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Yier mod ARK: Survival Evolved ZIP kata folda moting'o .mod descriptor kod mod mod molos kode. Synix somo ID mar Workshop kuom descriptor, to ok nying ZIP. Files ok go kata keto: bang ' nono, Synix medo ActiveMods kod ModIDS ne yo ma ARK golo godo gik moko. Map kod loko duto nyalo dwarore ni olos server mopogore. Package mar ASA CurseForge ok owinjore.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Mani ok en ohala mar ASE mod chuth. Ket weche manie .mod descriptor kod mod folder ma luwore gi mod.info kod gik moketie. Nyukta mar ID moting'o gimoro nyaka luwre gi nying moro amora. Raw Workshop .z downloads maonge fail mar .mod ok riw lwedo gi japuonjni; Ti gi Mod IDs kar mano.

data.name: ArkPackages.Error.WrongEdition
data.value: Gasedni oting'o ranyisi mar gaset machielo mar ARK. Mods mag ASE Steam Workshop kod mods mag ASA CurseForge ok nyal lokore. Yier paket mar server moyier.

data.value: Migepe ma iserito mag kelo gik moko e pinje mamoko ok nyal tiyo kata gin mag ot machielo. Ne ok otim lokruok moro amora.

data.name: Content.04306C6DCC8E032536F2
data.value: Ket chenro moro amora mar weche manie iye kod filelist.xml kanyachiel kendo inyalo tiyo gi chenro mag weche manie server. Weche duto motudore gi weche moler e bugego; ng'eyo yoregi masani.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Ti gi puonjni e loso server mari mokwongo. Synix tiyo kode e kompyuta, omiyo we kompyuta orieny sama ji tugo. Ok ochuno ni nyaka indik chikni mondo ichakgo tijno.
1. Yaw Synix kae to iwe SteamCMD otiek nono kaka ogene. 2. Yier Add Server, kae to ilos server manyien. Kapo ni oserwarno nitie, to yier Import Existing Server kar mano. 3. E weche mag General, ket nying server moro makende kae to iyier tugono. Yier gocho mar gocho, gocho mar tugono, kata gima inyalo ting'o kapo ni ineno wechego. 4. Bed gi paro mowinjore, mak mana ka dwarore ni itim gimoro mopogore. Non ane weche ma yudore e ite mag keto gik moko obed mayot, kae to iyud weche ma dwarore ni iket piny. 5. Yier Save Server. Mani medo weche e dashboard; mano ok nyis ni tugono osechopo. 6. Yier gima idonjo kae to iyier Chak. We mondo download kod ikruok mokwongo otiek, ka iluwo weche duto ma Synix nyiso. 7. Ti gi chenro moro amora mar tugono, kaka timo singruok, donjo e ot ka ot, kata loso saison e server manager manie tuke. 8. Bed gi thuolo mar tudori gi kompyuta kata achiel kuom gik mamoko manie Intanet. Bang' ka mano osetiyo, inyalo timo backups kapok imedo modi kata timo lokruoge madongo.
Kapo ni Iwinjo ka Chunyi Ng'ol Open Ready for the selected server kendo som Activity & Diagnostics. Luw gima okethoreno kar goyo "Start" nyadinwoya. Kuom wach Minecraft kata Satisfactory, weche momedore malero okenge ma dwarore.
Bedo gi joma ok ni e riwruok mar oganda Jehova en okang' motudore gi riwruok mar oganda Jehova. Mokwongo, yie ing'e ni serverno tiyo e alworawa.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Ng'ato ka ng'ato madonjo e dashboard nyaka bed gi nyinge kod folda mare owuon. Synix loko nying server mondo obed ng'at ma onge hinyruok mar Windows e weche mag folda kod chako. Timo kamano miyo ok wanyal pogo weche moko gi jomamoko e yo moro amora; ok en masindno kata tong' mar sirkal.
DHOK MA NYASAYE • C:\Synix ?? kar tich maduong' mar data mar Synix. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD • C:\Synix\Games\<game>\<server> ?? keto server e yo mapile. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ?? soko mar konyruok. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? buge mag kwayo kod ripot mag masira.
Fayilo mag application mag MSI kare yudore e bwo %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Moko kuom gik ma idwaro timo kod moko kuom gik moting'o gweth mag Windows bende gin mag account mar Windows.
DHOK MA JOKRISTO Nigo Ti gi Migawo mar Siro kod Telo sama iyiero folda mar server. Ka idwaro keto program manyien, yier folda moro ma onge kama inyalo ndikie kendo ma nigi kar dak moromo mar tuke kod weche manyien. Kik iket profils ariyo e adres achiel.
Open Server Folder nyiso kama server moyierno nitie. Open Backup Folder nyiso kama oseketie; Kik ing'e yo moro amora kaluwore gi nying' ma ne onyisgo.
RWOK nyalo dak kamoro amora Tugo moro nyalo kano piny e AppData, Documents, kata e kompyuta machielo. Tem ng'eyo kama inyalo konye ka pok idwoko kata iloko program.
Tiyo gi nying manyien kata loko folders e File Explorer ok nyis ni yo moro amora ma iserito biro bedo manyien. Ti gi Synix ma konyo tiyo gi yore mag import/transfer kod yore mag nono kapok ichako tich. Nitie kuonde mopogore opogore bende ma ok ochuno ni gibed gi doko mag otas.

data.name: Content.04B9D3E7C29AEA747A53
data.value:
THOKO MA MUMA CHUNYORE:
1. Ti gi masinde mag server dichiel mondo ichak 'UDKDedServerSettings.ini', kae to igolgi oko.
2. Tim lokruok e fom mar loso weche mondo iket weche mitiyogo e tiyo gi server kod yore mag tugo.
3. Weche mag Ofis: https://subsistence.fandom.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers tiyo gi Dedicated Server Manager mare, ma Synix nyaka bedogo. Ka ichako yawone, yier Local/Console, yier Continue to server configuration, ket chenro mar server kod piny, kendo yier Save & start. Ti gi admin mondo iyud kuonde mitiegoe weche, piny, mod, jorit, kod konsoli. Synix kano ranyisino e bwo folda mar Instance mar server. Yore mar Local/Console e nyim ok dwar ratiro mag jarit; timo tich mar Windows timo kamano. Dwaro mag sirkal gin .NET Framework 4.8 kata moko manyien, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 kod 2017, kata 6 GB mar system RAM, kod port UDP 27016 ma iyudo kokalo kuom Firewall mar Windows kendo itiyo kode e router mar joluo mag Intanet. Puonj mar Ofis: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Ng'at matimo nonro nono chenro mag server kendo onyalo chako chango jogo moseng'ado mar tiyo kode bang ' wuok e ot apoya kata yudo chandruok moro.
WECHE MA NYASAYE TIMO Ti gi chike mag Synix mar Stop and Restart mondo itim lokruok. Synix riwo lwedo chenrogo gi riwruok mar jarit mondo kik kethi mar tijno obed gima rach.
Loso program mar tugono, tieko programno e Task Manager, kata golo programno e program machielo, nyalo nenore ka gima ok nyalre kendo nyalo kelo lokruok.
WECHE MA WACHO NYUMA Geng'o server mar Synix, kae to inon sigand tuke manyien. Rieyo kinde mar tiyo, chenro, dho wath, paro, kata mod kapok ichako kendo. Recovery ok nyal rieyo mod maok nyal luwore kata chenro mar tuke ma pok otieko.
Kata kamano, nitie gik mang'eny ma nyalo miyo ng'ato oket pache e yo makare. Kinde ma ng'ato onego oduog e timno otenore kuom kaka otiyo gi thuolono kod chal mare masani, omiyo kik ipar ni nitie kinde moro amora ma ng'ato nyalo dong'e matin.
Rieyo Synix wuotho e wi gige tich makonyo ji kod weche mag nyithindo ma gin mag server. Masinde mag kompyuta kata masinde mag tiyo gi kompyuta ma gitiyogo e timo tijno nyalo bedo moti ahinya moloyo masindno kendo nyalo dwarore ni oti gi masinde mag loyo mich.
WATCHDOG ok nyal kawo kar backups ma osetim maber kata rito server manyien ka ochako tiyo maber.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Ti gi baton mar ngima mar Synix e tiyo ne server e yo makare. Mano miyo ng'at matimo nonro neno pogruok mantie e kind chungo ng'ato gi masira moro.
Chakruok Yier gima idonjo kae to iyier Chak. Synix nono gik madwarore, yore mag wuoth, dho wath, kod rit ma ne oyier kapok ochak, iko fail ma onge kendo ochako tiyo gi server. Tem kendo kinyiso ni idwaro timo kamano.
Weuru Yier STOP kae to iyie mondo tugono orit kendo ogeng'. Synix tiyo gi ng'ado mar tieko tijno ka nitie, kae to bang'e otiyo gi ng'ado mar tieko tijno ka dwarore. Chuno ng'ato mondo otiek tich nyalo miyo olal dongruok mosetim.
RESTART Yier Restart mondo ichung' ne grup masani mar process kendo ichak chenro manyien. Kik ichak goyo kopi machielo gi lweti sama itimo kamano.
Kapo ni Ok Inyal Yudo Buton Lendo machielo nyalo bedo ni nigi server, kata onyalo bedo e bwo chal mar lokruok, kata onyalo tiyo gi chenro ma oko. Som ote moting'o gik mitimo kod nyalo mar profilingno.
Kik iketh server e Task Manager kata kik itweye kuom gimoro amora ma ok otudore gi tij rito gik moko. Mano nyalo nenore ka gima en wuoth ma ok wapar ni biro kelo lokruok.
Tugo tuke mitimo kokalo kuom masinde mag intanet kata tije mamoko mag konyo ji, dwaro ni gitim nonro mar ngimagi giwegi. Bedo ni misonari oserumo, mano ok nyis ni tijegi osegony.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory dwaro ni iket chenro mokwongo mar tiyo gi Server Manager mare owuon e tuke. Synix nyalo keto kendo chako server mochiw, to ok okaw kar kwayo server kata chweyo session mare.
GIMA MUMA WACHO 1. Tim weche mag Satisfactory kae to ichakgi gi Synix. 2. Rit mondo server mochiw otiek ting'o. 3. Open Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager kendo medo kata yiero server. 4. Ket kode, ket password mar admin, kendo inyalo donjo kaka admin. 5. Tim kata igo program midwaro tiyogo.
Synix ochung' ne nengo mar chako/kido mar iko ma inyalo tigo, moriwo nyaka port mar chako kod MaxPlayers. Fichego inyalo tigo e bwo FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
WECHE MA NITIE gi SYNIX 1. Ket server matiyo gi -NewConsole. Check imported or older entries; sama idwoko penjono, chak ane kendo Synix. 2. Ti gi ratiro mar Windows maromre gi mar Synix kod mar server, to ber ka itiyo gi ratiro mag joma tiyo kode. 3. Yier serverno kendo ilos Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Yier tudruok achiel kachiel kae to irito.
Synix oro server.GenerateAPIToken, osomo weche duto manyien ma owuokgo, onono API mar dala, kendo orito tokeni moketi kod kod kodhi mar Windows. Tokenno miyo japuonj thuolo mar ng'eyo, to ok mana rito gik moko kende.
Ripot mag nyak Token oserito kendo okan e yo makare kendo oyawo Overview. Ok ochuno ni in iwuon ikop weche manie konzoli kata idok kode e yor lwedo.
Kapo ni temno ok odhi maber, Synix biro rito tudruok moro amora mosekano chon kendo ok obi temo chikno kendo. Som gima ne otimore kapok itemo kendo.
Mani tudore gi server moyier e kompyuta; ok ochuno ni ng'ato obed gi chik manyien mar router mar Synix. Chakruok, Chungo, kod Chako Duto pod tiyo maonge API.

data.name: Content.1734B5184A8732EBE5C7
data.value:
Yier gima idonjo e dashboard kae to ilos Options of Server. Mana gige tich moting'o weche ma luwogi kende ema inyalo chiw.
Fichego kod Ritogi • Open Server Folder kod Open Backup Folder oyawo kuonde mitimoe dongruok. • Jarit mar locho e yo mochanore biro yawo weche moting'o weche mag loso tuke. • Update Server golo weche manyien mag tugo ma sirkal oyiego. • Tim nonro e weche mag Game Files kata rieyo weche ma jomisonari tayo. • Backup and Restore, orito kata duoko gik moyier. • Create Batch File otero script mar chako ka profil riwe lwedo. • Delete golo weche moko kendo ochiwo mana yore ma inyalo golgo fail moler e barua mar kwayo.
WECHE MA NYASAYE WECHE MA NYASAYE NYASAYE Weche mag tudruok nyiso adirese, kuonde ma idhiye, kod gik mitimo e loko. Tembe mag tudruok, Mod & Plugin Manager, Minecraft gige tich, kod Satisfactory Control Center nenore kama itiyogo.
Nono Jatichno Matimo Lendo Dwok barupeno mondo ing'e weche momedore e wi server. Weche machuok mag ngima nyiso gik ma ne ochakgo, jogo ma ne tiyo gi konzo, kod joma ne tiyo kode. Game ma nigi process mang'eny nyalo bedo gi ID mar process mokalo achiel.
Ti gi masindno mondo inon CPU mar serverno kod histori mar paro. Weche molergi opogore gi weche duto ma yudore e dashboard.
Golo weche e yo mayot kata keto chenro mar nono gik moko ok bi miyo tugono orum. Ti gi weche manie dashboard ma wacho ni "Stop" sama idwaro timo kamano.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Yier gocho mar Minecraft kapok iyiero mod kata chenro mag tudruok. Java kod Bedrock gin kit server mopogore opogore; Bedrock ok en loader mar Java.
Ket Jatichno 1. Yud weche mag Minecraft kendo yier Java kata Bedrock. 2. Kuom Java, yier version mar Minecraft, loader, kod version mar loader molos gi joma yiero. 3. Non piny, yore mag tuke, tong' mar jatuwo, paro, dho wath, kod kuonde moting'o weche motudore gi sirkal. 4. Rito kendo chako tiyo gi Synix. 5. Som chenro moro amora kapok iyie kode. 6. Warit mondo piny duto otiek ting'o gik moko kae to iriwri gi weche ma luwogi. 7. Tim nonro mar tich kapok imedo timo lokruok.
Java kod BEDROCK Yiero mar Java oriwo Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, kod Purpur kama olosore. Ti gi weche ma yudore e Muma kendo iged gik ma inyalo yiero; Paper kod Purpur tiyo gi plugins, to Fabric, Forge, kod NeoForge tiyo gi modgi mowinjore. Synix golo thuolo mar tiyo ma oyier kuom jatichne molony.
Bedrock tiyo gi paket mar Bedrock Dedicated Server kendo ok oti gi Java.
RITU gi Yore mag Tiego Yier gima idwaro ni itim. Winjruok e kind Minecraft, loader, gik ma ng'ato dwaro, kod gik mamoko ma dwarore kuom japuonj.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, kod paket mag plugin-server ok nyal lokore. Tiyo gi mod kata plugins ok nyal miyo ng'ato oti gi loader kata server. Browse Catalog ok en modpack mod or dependency installation.
Ranyisi Configure ochung'ne server.properties kod weche motudore gi gocho. Java bende chiwo yore mag Spectator. Weche mag tiegruok kod chike mag tiegruok biro bedo kaka Minecraft dwaro.
Chak gi Minecraft Control Center. E ite mar Settings, oting'o weche motudore gi chenro ma inyalo loki. Edit File konyo e loso weche; Jandiko molony chiwo jandiko ma ong'eyo fom ma nitie. Giduto girito lokruoge ka server ochung'. Walo mag server.properties ma ong'ere kaka ports, player limit, world, seed, mode, kod command-channel settings bende nyalo miyo weche ma iserito mar Synix obed manyien. Nying molos/MOTD opogore gi nying' modak e alworau. Lokruoge mag mod maok ong'ere siko e fisegi giwegi.
Synix medo somo kuondego ka pok ochako loso kata chako weche modonjo, kendo sama itiyo gi Refresh ka ok itiyo kodgi. Kapo ni lokruok mar oko ok en gima kare kata ok winjre gi weche mamoko, rieyo wachno kar chako server nyading'eny. Jarit otamore ndiko weche ma ne oloki chakre chieng ' ma ne oyawgie; yawgi kendo mondo gikel weche manyien.
GIMA JATIM GASET TIMO Timuru backup mar server duto kapok uloko version kata loader. Yier kinde manyien mar tiyo e Setiup, ket weche ma isenono, kae to yier Tiyo gi kinde mar tiyo e Minecraft Control Center. Synix iko sa mar dhi e tijno kar kende, orito server.properties kod folda mag piny, kendo oriko weche ma ne oket kare. Ok ochak tiyo gi server. Chakruok ok nyal dhi nyime ka kinde ma ne itiyogo kod profil ma ne iyiero ok winjre.
Loko failo ok nyal tieko lokruok mosetim bang' ka oserwar osechako. Kik ipar ni piny moro ma ne oyaw gi Minecraft manyien kata mod mopogore opogore ne nyalo ting'o maber gi kinde machon mar tiyo; Kar mano, dwokuru gik moko duto.
We timo kamano kapok iloko fail ma dwaro ni ichak iti kodgi kendo. Kik ichak tiyo gi yo machuok mar loso piny manyien.
Kapo ni JUTIO ok nyal riwore Non ane weche ma yudore e gasedno, weche mag game/loader, mods madwarore, kod chike mag port/protocol mar gasedno moyier. Mondo ing'e kaka inyalo wuok chon, ne weche ma yudore e gaset mar tuke mondo ine ka be nitie ketho mag winjruok, tiyo gi kinde, paro, kata bedo maluor.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Wuo gi Satisfactory Control Center bang' tudori gi API. Yier tab ma idwaro tiyogo.
Ranyisi Machuok Yier Refresh mondo isom nying chokruok, kwan mar joluo motudore, chal mar tuke, ratiro mar dhiyo, seche mag tugo, kod okang' mar teknoloji.
Joluo mar dashboard ng'adoga lokruok e yo masie ka tudruok ni kare; Tabul mar Weche Duto iloso e yo manyien ka okwayo. API chiwo kwan mag jogo, to ok list mar jogo ma nigi nyingegi. Bedo gi thuolo mar wuoyo kata bedo gi server ma rito puonjruok ok en gima inyalo geng'.
SETINGS mag JOSER Yier Refresh, ilok gik ma itiyogo, kae to ilok lokruok. Non ane kendo gik ma pod odong' kapok ochopo. Nitie yore moko madwarore ni ichak tijno kendo; timo lokruoge moko ok nyal miyo tugono chakore kendo.
Weche moting'o tigo kod nengo ma ng'ato oyiego pod yudore e dhok ma jogo tiyogo.
THOG MA INYALO PARO • Save now: Ket nying kata ti gi nying Synix machon. Tiyo gi nying'no kendo nyalo ketho weche ma oseketi. • Migawo moyier: Non ane weche moler. Synix keto weche motudore gi dongruok mokwongo sama chokruok dhi nyime; Gichuno nyalo ketho tudruok e kind jotugo. • Upload save: Omedo fail moyier kendo onyalo kawo kar filo ma nigi nying' achielno. Ok oting'e gik moko duto. • Download moyier: Keto kopi e yo miyiero.
Bed gi riwruok mar riwruok mar oganda Jehova kapok ichako tiyo ne piny moro maduong'. Weche mag rito pesa nigi tong' mar ritruok mar 512 MB. API nyalo bedo maonge kuom kinde ka ng'ato timo kamano.
WECHE MA MUMA NYASAYE Wuo gi jotugo achiel kachiel kae to isom barua mar singruok. Scripts, tokens/password commands, kod loko mag yudo weche ma ok ni kare ogeng'e kae.
Weche ma nyiso ni ng'ato onego owe tiyo gi Synix. Puonjno biro siko e dirisa to ok ibiro ket e dashboard kata Synix text log; Kata kamano, pod onyalo ndiko buge owuon.

Fichni mag tuke ma jokinda mang'eny nyalo dwarore:
Synix keto paket mar server mochiw, to ok onyal golo, kwedo, kata pogo kuonde mamoko e tuke mapile. Kapo ni server nyiso ni nitie gik ma onge e program mar multiplayer kata ni nitie gik ma okethore sama ichiko kata iloko map, ket program mar Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer kokalo kuom Steam kitiyo gi achiel kuom askeche. Kopa weche manie mpsrc manyaka tugo gi ji mang'eny e program mar tugono e folda mar server, kendo tem neno ni mapcycle.txt kod maplist.txt oting'o map midwaro tiyo.
Jatiyo ma keto server nyaka ti gi okang'no. Weche mag tuke kaka 0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, kod 4 Colosseum.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Som gima Connect biro kelo ka pok itemo kendo. Puonj moro ma yudore e kompyuta mar tugono ok nyis ni weche duto ma nokorgo ne otony.
TEM ANE KINDE MACHON • Konzoli ok yudre: Tem neno ni -NewConsole, ma en server moyier, kod kwan mar ratiro mag Windows chalre. • Puonj ma ne ok otieko: Lerri iwuon. Synix ok bi goye. • Chik tiyo to onge gimoro ma ok nyal yud: We mondo tij chako otiek, ne weche mag tuke ma inyalo ndik, kendo we mondo weche manyien ochopi. • Filta ma nyalo chocho weche: Gonyo kata golo filta kendo weyo mondo konzoli odwok wach. • Port mar API en mar tich machielo: Tim lokruok kuom port mar tuke ma ne itimo ne server moyier. Kik ior wachne ne ng'at ma ok winj wachne. • Ok nyal gonyo token ma ne otam kata ma ne oketo mar tudruok: Ti gi token e yo maber, kae to ilok kode. • API ok yudre: Warit ka ichako tiyo kata iket gik ma idwaro loyo kae to ing'i weche mag tuke.
Dwoko manyien nyalo bedo gi nengo ma chalre gi mar dwoko machon. Yudo gimoro otiyo gi weche molos bang ' chikno, to ok tiyo gi ranyisi machon e kind gik ma ne otimore.
KINDE MACHON Satisfactory goyo simbe mag jarit e konsole mare owuon kod buge. Ketgi tenge kendo gol tong' mag ranyisi e pichni kod ripode.
Synix biro fwenyo ni kar giko mar lowo en mar server moyier kendo obiro pino nyasino. Kik igeng' thieth mar sirkal mondo ikony ng'ato loyo chandruok moro.
Golo tokeni ma iserito oko mar tudruok mar Synix; ok ogol tokeni e server.
Mondo igol tokens mag application ma nitie, ti gi server.InvalidateAPITokens e server console kata Server Manager console mar Satisfactory. Timo kamano bende nyalo konyo joma tiyo gi tokens mamoko.
Ka ok nyal tiyo gi tudruok mochan mar Windows machielo, kata ka ok nyal tiyo gi tudruok mochanno.

data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Som weche machuok e wi gik ma ne itimo kod tuke ma ne itimo. Non ane kethruok mokwongo to ok mana wach mar tieko tijno.
TEGO KIT NG'ATO KA CHIENG' OCHIENG' 1. Yie gi folda moyier mar keto gik moko, ma inyalo tiyoe, gocho mar tuke, kod loader. 2. Non weche madwarore, thuolo mar RAM/disk, kod kuonde ma idhiye. 3. Chop singruok moro amora, inyalo donjo e account, inyalo kwayo mich moro, kata inyalo keto chenro mar chokruok. 4. Mondo iyud mods, pim weche motudore gi tugono, loader, gik ma ng'ato timo, kod gik ma japuonjre dwaro. 5. Tem nono Synix kapok iloko fail, kae to itim nonro mokwongo.
Jawuond mangima nyalo dong' bang' ka server mar adier oselal. Sewer maber bende nyalo rito mondo ochop e piny mangima kata onyalo bedo gi penjo maok nyal yudo/API. Nonuru chalgi e yo mopogore.
WACHO kata chako kendo kawo kinde Tugo tuke dwaro ni ng'ato oyud thuolo moromo mar rito kendo tieko tije mag jotich. Rit mondo ine kaka Synix biro tiyo kae to isom ote mar tijno. Ka ng'ato odok chien, ok onyal dhi nyime timo dongruok.
Kik iketh chenro mag timo gik moko kanyachiel, kik ichak tiyo gi kopi machielo, kata kik iti gi jang'ad bura machielo e kedo gi masindno.
Gige Tiyo Koso Gik Moko Duto Olal Non ane nyalo mar profilingno kod chal mare sani. Nitie yore moko ma inyalo gonygo nikech tugono nigi jogo kata nikech onge yo mar locho. N/A player data ok en masira mar server.
Kapo ni chandruogno pod dhi nyime, ndik gima ne itimo, kethruok ma notimore gadier, kod weche machuok moting'o weche moko kapok itimo lokruoge mamoko.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
TEG KIT MODPACK mar Server 1. Tim backup mar server duto kae to igeng'e. Ti gi Synix gi ratiro mapile mag Windows. 2. Ket kendo iti gi yo makare mar Minecraft, loader, kod loader. 3. E Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, yier Import Server Pack. Yier Modrinth .mrpack kata server ZIP moting'o mod/plugins kod fail mag chenro. 4. Mods mag server ma ok oyier ibiro wilgo mak mana ka ok oyier Mods mag Server ma ok oyier. Weche mag Modrinth kod weche mag ng'ado bura ne japuonjre kende ok onego okel. 5. Non ane nonro ma ne otim, nonro mar metadata, weche ma ne ok ondik, kod gik moko duto ma ne dwarore ni omed, okaw kargi, kata ogol. Ne ni nitie kuonde moko ma ne itimoe nonro. 6. Tim tijni gi lwedo bang ' ketogi, som konsoli, kendo item tudruok ma kamano.
Ng'at mokelo ok ti gi script mag chako tiyo gi paket, ok okaw kar piny, kata ok ondik weche moko e wi root server.properties. Gol pak mar server duto mar jandiko kapo ni CurseForge client export oting'o mana download manifest kende. Golo gik moko e kompyuta, golo gik moko e ot, kata ting'o gik moko e ot, dwaro ni jandiko okonygi gi weche ma gitiyogo. Synix ok nyal geng'o tong' ma jomisonari oketo.
Dwoko mar Modrinth en hash-checked. Ka ok itiyo gi JAR, ibiro nono ka be nitie ng'at mitimo tij loader, weche moting'o mana gik ma jorit tiyogo, ID ariyo, kod gik ma otenore kuom JAR. Weche ma ok ong'ere kendo ma nigi kuonde mopogore opogore mag loko Muma dwarore ni onon. Ka ng'ato otimo nonro maler kata ka ok onyal fwenyo gik ma kelo ywaruok, mano ok nyis ni mod en gima ber. Gik ma ok ochuno ni ng'ato obed gi winjruok maber gi nyawadgi ok nyal gologi aling' ling'.
Kuom dok e piny gi nyingno, inyalo golo JARs ma ne itiyogo chon ma koro onge, to mana ka gik moko duto pod luwore gi hash ma ne ondikgi. JAR kod fail mag piny ma ok oting'o jolok ohala ok nyal gol oko. Fichni mag loso gik moko mayudore e paket manyien nyalo kawo kar machon; Fweny ma ne okor nyiso gigo ka pok ing'ado mar timo kamano. Bed gi nying mar fayilo mar server-ZIP ma chalre sama iloso pakno mondo okwan kaka paket achiel.
GIMA JI TIMO E PINY NGIMA Ti gi piny mondo inyis piny ma ji ong'eyo. Kony piny gi ZIP mondo okop piny moro e yo machal gi mano e folda manyien; ok ondik piny ma nitie kata ok olok piny e kind Java kod Bedrock. Yier piny moting'o kendo ti gi piny mondo ilok nying level kod piny mar Synix. Chakruok maluwo biro ting'o piny moyier. Loko kodhi kelo piny manyien, to ok lowo masani.
THOKO Yudo gik moko e yo makare oriwo lokruoge ma osetim e odno. Undo duoko fail machon ma ne ondikgo kata golo fail ma lokruokno nokelo. Lokri kik idonj e piny moro ma ji ogoloe gik moko kae to iweye. Kapo ni osetimnegi lokruok bang'e, Synix otamore ndikogi. Ket weche duto ma iseloso kendo ti gi gasedno e yo mowinjore kapo ni mano dwarore.
A pending recovery blocks Start until recovery is finished and the saved entry agrees with the restored files. Masinde machon maok nigi ranyisi mar kinde ma gitiyogo e tijno, dwaro ni oket kuonde mokethore mondo otigo seche ma gitiyogo e tijno. Backup dhi nyime bedo backups duto mag folda mar server, maok otenore kuom weche mag lokruok.
Bang' ka osedok kare chuth, weche machon mag loko kar tich ikwano ni gin kuonde moket kare. Kata obedo ni ok ginyal gonyo weche ma ne odwokgo, pod ginyalo nenore. Kelo kata rieyo gik moko bang' ka osedwokogi, kelo weche manyien.
TEMBE MA NYALO KONYO JI OYIENY Nonro mar nonro osenono weche ma ne otimore e kind gik ma ne timore e ndalo mokalo kod weche ma ne otimore bang' masira mar Java, weche ma ji paro, gik ma ng'ato oketoe pache kuom gimoro, gik ma timorega e piny, koda chandruoge ma yudo ka ng'ato otimo gimoro marach. Onge ranyisi moro amora ma ok onyal fwenyore manyiso ni misonari en ng'at maber. Tiyo gi gik moko e yo maber biro miyo ng'ato obed gi teko mar neno gik moko; CPU kod RAM ok nyal kawo kar ng'iyo weche mag tuke.
Schedules yawo kuonde ma Synix chako kendo ritoe. Yier odiechieng' kod sa midwaro, tim mar rito joluo, timo backups, kod timo lokruok, kae to inon kendo irit. Kama itiyogo ok nyal chweyo chenro mar ariyo kata loko chenroni.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Yier server mar Minecraft, kae to iyaw Server Options → Minecraft Control Center. Websait mar Console kod Players miyo joluo bedo gi chike kaachiel gi gige tich ma gitiyogo. Websait mamoko chiwo kuonde mitimoe lokruok, piny, weche momedore, timo bakup mar server duto, chako kendo timo chenro, chango, kod nonro.
TICH MAG WECHE Gik ma itiyogo nyalo tiyo gi Synix-managed console, localhost management channel, kata RCON. Yo ma gitiyogo nyalo luwore gi yo ma gitiyogo kod kaka gitiyo gi server.
Okang' moro mopondo nyalo weyo chenro mar chik ma ne itiyogo e alwora. Kapo ni ok idwar chiko gimoro, ne ni server tiyo kendo ni gik ma itiyogo e loye gin adier.
TICH MOCHUNG'RE Ka okonyore, Synix chiwo lendo, list mag jotugo, ritruok, loko mar operator kod list mag joma oyie, chiko seche kod chal mar kor lwasi, kendo rito pesa.
Yier gima idwaro timo kae to isom gima itimo kapok iyie gi wachno. Bedo gi ratiro mar tiyo gi masindno miyo wabedo gi ratiro mar timo tuke. Kik iyie gi wachno mana nikech idwaro tieko ywaruok moro.
TICH MA GIMA JI OYIEGO Ti gi weche molos e gochono. Chike kaka list kod save-all gin gik ma itiyogo e tuke kendo ok olokgi gi Synix interface. Non ane chike moting'o chike mag tuke kapok ioro chik ma loko piny kata ratiro.
NG'ENO MA NYASAYE Penjo moro nyalo miyo ng'ato kwan mar jotugo ma onge nying ' mar jogo. Tabul ma onge nying' ok nyis ni ng'ato onge gi tudruok.
Ti gi dashboard mar Stop kata Restart e timo lokruok e ngima ng'ato mondo omi jorit ong'e ni tijno en gima ong'ado.
Ket RCON mar yiero kata kuonde ma itiyogo mondo itigo weche mag otigo e yo mayot, mak mana ka in gi chenro mar tiyo gi yorno. Jogo duto ok onego onyis ni gin gi ratiro mar timo kamano.

14.5 Riwruokni kod Ritruok mar Donjo
Donjo dwaro password mari kod passkey kata authenticator, kaka Google Authenticator. Akaunti ma osechan mondo oluw yore ariyogo, orito chike ariyogo. Loko password, pogo kompyuta e websait, kod golo akaunt mar maneja dwaro ni otim nonro manyien kuom lokruok ma kamano.
Kata kamano, ka ng'ato ok nyal tiyo gi weche ma ok ochuno, to onyalo tiyo gi weche ma ok ochuno. Yie mar timo kamano oriwo tiyo gi browser achiel, tiyo gi kompyuta achiel, tiyo gi server ma oketo kendo tiyo gi tuke mag ngima kuom dakika adek. Ka ng'ato ogeng'o, ochako tiyo kendo, oketo konzoli e yo maber, kata oketo konzoli e yo maber, kata ok otimo gimoro maber, ok obi yudo chike mamoko. Golo kata pando tab mar manager tieko yie gi tabno. Buto mag tiyo gi server mapile siko ka nigi dwaro mar donjo. Yore ma jogo tiyogo e loso gik moko ok oyienegi ndiko e yor chik mar Windows.
Kompyuta moting'o weche ariyo mayudore e websaitno nyalo chiwo weche moting'o weche moting'o weche mosekalo kapo ni wiyi owil gi weche moting'o weche moting'o weche moting'o weche moting'o weche manie websaitno. Ok onyal yiero weche mamoko. Wach mar sirkal mar kinde machuok ok nyal geng'o kata golo gik ma idwaro e wi wach sirkal/ng'at malong'o adiera, kendo nyaka iyier wach mar sirkal manyien kapok idonjo e admin. Ka ichopo weche duto ma ne isomo, inyalo gonyo gik mamoko ma ne itimo e browser.
Ng'at matayo Synix rito alama mar donjo e browser e pach tab masani, to ok e cookies, kama okanie weche, kata kama okanie weche. Ka ng'ato oloso kata tieko tab, ok onyal donjo. Mano ok geng'o barupeni kata jarit weche moting'o weche moting'o weche migeno kik okan ka oyiero, kendo ok oting'o cookies moket kargi giwegi gi joma chiwo kuonde mitimoe hosting/sekuriti kata gi tich mar loko websait mar ji duto.
Inyalo weyo tiyo gi kompyuta, inyalo gonyo tijni duto, kata inyalo ketho kompyuta. App mar Synix ma yudore e alworau nyalo golo kendo ketho tudruok ma en-go gi ji ka ok odonjo e websaitno. Sama ok itiyo gi intanet, otieko tiyo gi Intanet e yo mabor kendo temo golo websait ka nitie tudruok. Ka ichako tiyo gi app kata Windows kendo, ok inyal duoko gik moko obed manyien. Pod inyalo tigo mana e alwora ma gidakie.
14.6 Hosting, Websait mag Ji Duto, kod Sirkal
Websait mar sirkalno tiyo gi chenro mar OpenAI mar pidho kuonde mitimoe websaitwa kod mag Cloudflare mondo okonygo e chiwo weche, kano weche, rito weche, koda miyo ji thuolo. Jogi tiyo gi weche madwarore e chiwo migepego kendo ginyalo yudo adres mag IP, kwayo wich, seche, kod weche mamoko motudore gi tudruok, kata rito weche ma gitiyogo kod kopi mag kony. Puonj ma gin-go e wi weche motudore gi weche maling'ling' ma gitiyogo: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ kod https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Tije mag loko weche e yo machuok kod mag golo weche manie GitHub gin mag joma chiwo wechego. Jarit maloso buge mag dhok mopogore opogore ok nyal tiyo gi weche molok e dhok ma ji ong'eyo, kendo ok oting'e weche molok e dhok ma ji ong'eyo. Synix ok nyis ni ka ng'ato odonjo e websait moro amora, to ok ochakgo cookies, logs, kata weche momaki. Inyalo chiwo bende weche ma chik dwaro; Chikno ok nyis ni ng'ato ok onego odonj e richo moro amora.
Synix tiyo gi riwruok mar ariyo ma nigi ratiro, kwayo mag kompyuta moting'o ondik, tudruok mag otese mopwodhi, ng'ado paro e wi gik ma biro timore e kaunti, kod yie kuom kinde machuok mondo okonygo joma onge ratiro mar donjo. Gik ma kamago ok nyal miyo tudruok gi ng'ato obed maonge hinyruok moro amora, kata ok ginyal miyo ng'ato ritore kuom lweny moro amora, kompyuta/browser ma okethore, yore mag ng'eyo ma okethore, kata tich ma okethore. Ket Synix kod Windows obed manyien, rit konyoni kod yore mag ng'eyo, kendo yie mana gi kompyuta koda kony ma in iwuon iwuoyogo.
Riwruogni yudore e adres mar https://synix.info/license/ kendo ondikgi e app mar Help Center kod installer. Penjo mag weche motudore gi ngima mar ng'ato ka ng'ato inyalo penjogi kokalo kuom yore mag kony ma sirkal tiyogo e adres mar https://synix.info/support/. Kik inyis weche moting'o weche mitiyogo, kod kodekni mag duoko chien, kata weche mamoko moting'o weche mag otas e ote ma sirkal tiyogo. Weche manyien mag ripotni oting'o lokruok manyien kod tarik manyien.

data.value:
Open Settings → Nyiso chandruok mondo iti gi ripot, kata ti gi kuonde mitiyoe gi kony moler piny kae.
Tim Mondo Chandruok Odog Maber Ket ranyisi mar yo mitimogo tijno, weche mag Synix kod Windows misebedo kitiyogo, weche motudore gi tuke/profilo, koda weche motudore gi gocho/gigo.
Ler ane: • Gik ma isetimo kata miseloko. • Gima ne irito kod gima notimore. • Ketho ma ne otimore gadier kod weche machuok ma ne ondik machiegni gi kinde. • Be chenrono ne tiyo chon kendo ang'o ma ne olokore?
Nono Weche Mokwongo Golo weche moting'o weche mopondo, tokens, URL mag webhook, yore mag ng'ato owuon, kod weche ma ok diher ni ji ong'e. Mode mar Pichuok ok nyal pwodho gik moko duto moting'o weche. Kik iket gik moko duto ma ne itiyogo e loso sigendni kata weche mag tuke maok inonogi.
Mondo iyud weche ma inyalo loke e dhokno, ket nying dirisa, kod weche moler e yo makare. Kuom wach moro motudore gi weche mag tuke, nyaka inyis chenro mar kuonde mitimogo gik moko kaachiel gi weche motudore gi tuke.
DHANO MACHON Ripot mag gocho: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Community Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Weche mag tich: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Tiego kata gero program ma nigi nyak ok nyal temo tuke duto, mod, kod kuonde mitimoe dongruok. Okenge maler mag golo gik moko e yo makare konyo e pogo chandruok mar Synix gi chandruok mar loso tuke kata mar ot.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Kwong iti gi sirkal mar server kapok itiyo gi chike manie piny. Yore moyierono nyiso ni en server mane ma tim moro biro mulo.
Yud Jatichno Ti gi sanduk mar manyo mondo ilos weche kitiyo gi nying tuke kata nying server. Filer mar status miyo listno bedo matin moloyo. Kapo ni weche moko nenore ni onge, gol filtra ariyogo kapok iparo ni ne ogolgi.
Som Weche Machuok • Servers moseketi ng'ado mar kwano weche ma osendiko kuom server. • Running Now nyiso weche ma sani iwuoyo kuomgi ni itimo. • Tiyo gi CPU kod tiyo gi RAM wuoyo kuom PC duto, to ok Synix kende. • Weche mag joluo yudore mana ka tugono nyiso ni ng'ato oseyudo gimoro.
NENRO MA NITIE Pile • Tim chenro mar chako, chungo, kod chako kendo tiyo gi server moyier. • Loso oting'o kuonde mitimoe lokruok. • Bedo moikore nono weche manyalo mone tiyo. • Websait mar Server Options oting'o weche motudore gi loso kod rito gik moko, tudruok kodgi, koda gige tich motudore gi tuke. • Dwok pichani diriyo mondo ine weche momedore e wi serverno.
Tiegruok kod nonro nyiso dongruok kod siem madwarore. Som ote mogik kapok itimo gimoro. CLEAR keto ler e alwora mar tich monenore; ok en chik mar golo fail duto mag odiechienge.
Ok ochuno ni nyaka ng'ato obed moikore ne tijno. Gichiko gik moko, ting'ogi e piny mangima, timo singruoge, koda loso tuke nyalo dhi nyime bang' ka chenro osetimore. Ng'e ni iikori e sigand tuke kendo inyalo riwri kodgi.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Open Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager mar profil mitimo. Synix nyalo fwenyo kuonde moting'o gik moko kod kuonde ma gidhiye; ok en buk moting'o weche duto.
TEG GIMA MUMA WACHO 1. Gwok piny, gik mamoko, kod chenro ma ne itiyogo. 2. We server oti gi Synix kae to irito mondo grup mar process owuog oko. 3. Non ane kuonde minyalo yudoe gik mamoko, kuonde mitiegoe gik moko, kod weche motudore gi ritruok. 4. Yier Guro e Fichier kata Kelo Package mondo ibed gi fichier, ZIP, kata folda mar mod. Yiero ma ng'ato nyalo timo otenore kuom chenro mar tuke. 5. Non kama idhiye, non ane gik ma ne otimore, siem ma ne ochiw, kod weche ma ne okor. 6. Weuru mondo tich mar chano gik moko, timo konyruok, kod keto gik moko obed manyien otiek. 7. Synix medo ler mar list ka otieko gedo. Ka dwarore, chako kendo, kae to item weche mag tuke kod tudruok gi jatuwo.
Limo nyiso kama idwaro ketoe gik moko. Ti gi yor manyo mondo iyud weche momedore kaluwore gi nyingegi, kitgi, kuonde ma ne giyudoree, kata yo ma ne gidhiye. Otimo nonro kendo kae to orito gima ne oyierono ka pod nitie. Neno weche e yo mayot ok nyal geng'o weche duto.
Ket dirisa obed moikore sama itimo scan kata loko. Synix golo gik moko duto maok winjre nyaka chop giko. Kapo ni tim moro ok odhi maber, som ane kethone kendo ilos ndikono kapok itemo kendo.
TYPE mag Tich Yore mag tich makonyo gin kaka Minecraft JAR packages, Rust Oxide/uMod plugins, packages mag 7 Days to Die, Empyrion scenarios and server mods, ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop IDs, kod ARK: Survival Ascended provider IDs. Moko kuom sirkandego tiyo mana gi yore mag fwenyo gik ma timore, kata dwarore ni gibed gi chenro mar timo kamano mokwongo.
Kuom weche mag ng'eyo wuon ot, Synix otiyo gi yore mag loso gik moko e kinde ma tugono/jachiw-gino chiwo weche. Weche ma pok ogol ok nyal nono chon e alwora.
Gik ma Jonenogo Nyalo Timo to Ok Ginyal Timo Ogoyo gik moko e yo mopogore opogore, kendo gikwedo yore maok ni kare, tudruok, weche ma ok oyienegi tiyo, paket madongo, kuonde ma gidhiye nyadiriyo, koda fweny mag program marach.
Sken mar Defender ma ok nyal yudore kata maok ong'ere en siem, to ok gima nyiso ni nitie program moro marach. Nono gik moko e yo maler kod ndiko gik moko e yor hash bende ok nyis ni ng'ato nyalo geno gimoro. Mods tiyo gi ratiro mag Windows mar server.
GIMA JI OYIEGO WECHE MACHON Browse Catalog yawo websait mar jomisonari. Ok ogol gik moko duto motudore kodgi kata ok ogol modpack moro amora.
Geng'o server kapok ichako idho. Mano biro miyo ohala duto ma ne oyiergo okethre, kendo onyalo bedo gi gik mamoko mopogore opogore. Gichoko weche machon ma ne okorgo kendo golo weche ma ne okorgo. Golo gik moko manyien mokwongo ka giloso buge; Synix otamore loko faile ma oselok oko mar masindno kata tiyo gi masindni ma ok oket e bwo masindno. Weche machon mag kelo gik moko e pinje mamoko ok nyal bedo gi hashs mag gik ma ne okan-go.
Kuom ID ma jomisonari tiyogo, Remove Selected golo IDno kuom chenro mar Synix; ok en riwruok mar oganda Jehova. Synix ndiko lokruoge ma otimo, to ok lokruok duto mag lwedo. Timuru backup mag server duto: golo mod nyalo miyo piny obed ma ok nyal loye kata golo weche manie iye.
Tabel ma onge gimoro tiende en ni onge add-on ma ok nyal luwore gi kama idwaro keto kendo manyo. Yie iyud weche mag manyo kendo ikwong inon profil, folda, kod framework kapok iparo ni oseyud weche duto manie disk.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Open Add Server → Game Support Catalog mondo ine gima Synix ong'eyo e wi tuke kapok ichako ndiko. Katalogi tiyo gi weche mayudore e app ma iseketo.
1. Many nying tuke. 2. Ti gi gik machalo kaka, migawono, kod weche mamoko mondo iket piny. 3. Yier tugono kendo ilos weche moler e iye, kata dichiel kitiyo gi bathe. 4. Som weche moting'o siem, program mar server, gima dwarore, kod weche mag ng'eyo.
Yie mondo gikel ler kapo ni tugono onge apoya. Yiero mar Minecraft mar Java kod Bedrock gin achiel kuom yore mag tich mar chano gik moko kar tiyo gi yore ariyo mag timo lokruok.
Som Timbego e Yo Makare Profil nyalo chiwo chenro mar locho, keto weche e yo motelnegi, keto chenro mag chako tijno, kata konyo ji e yo matin. Ng'ato nyalo tiyo gi Steam AppID nyiso kaka masindno tiyo; ok onyis ni tuke duto osego.
Ng'at mochung ' motegno SteamCMD "dwaro" ochung'ne kwayo mar ng'ato mondo odonj e account. Jogo ma nigi ratiro mar bedo gi tuke kod chike mag jomisonari nyalo keto chike mamoko.
DHOTH MA NYASAYE OYIENEGO Ok Nyal Nyiso ni Gichalo gi Mach Kata kamano, ka ng'ato oketo ranyisi maber mar ng'at ma winjo penjo, mano ok nyis ni ng'atno en ng'at ma winjo penjo. Ti gi chenro mar tuke kod gik ma idwaro ni otim.
Kaluwore gi Muma, ng'ato ka ng'ato nyalo nono weche manie iye. Ripot mag nonro manie alworano nyiso gik ma ne otimore e kompyuta, to ok gik ma ne otimore e masin moro amora kata e masin moro amora.

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Yaw kido mar gear e dashboard mondo iyud kuonde mitimoe lokruok. Ti gi baton mar Configure mar server e keto gik moko mana kuom serverno kende.
JONENARAL • Nyis sirkal mar Server Console Window ka be server ma itiyogo nyiso konsoli margi. Fweny mopondo ok nyis ni server oserumo. • Loso weche e yo motimo mudho. • SteamCMD Download Speed yiero ni itimo download e okang' maromo nade kata ni itimo download e okang' maromo nade. • Lokruok mar dhokno ne siro weche mag tudruok, dialog, kod weche motudore gi chal mar ji.
Websait mamoko oting'o kuonde mag loko kod loko, weche motudore gi weche mag sirkal kod weche mag ritruok, ripot mar chandruok, koda gik ma oseketi mondo okony ng'ato. Ok ochuno ni nyaka ichak tiyo gi yore mamoko mag loso server.
Ranyisi mar Dhok Yier dhok ma inyalo tiyogo. Synix tiyo gi dhok moyier, weche ma konyo, kod ote ma olos gi app. Ok olok chike mag tuke, gik ma itiyogo e loso program, kod weche ma jorit osegoyo. Weche ma ne ondik chon e weche mag nonro, pod yudore.
Weche motudore gi tuke ok olok: chike, weche moting'o weche kod nengo, nying map, mode, nying fail, weche mag chako tich, gik ma nyiso ni ng'ato nitie, koda weche mag fwenyo gik mowuokgo nyaka dhi nyime mana kaka tuke dwaro.
Loko dhok mar tudruok ok nyal loko weche mag chike mag tuke kata loko weche mag konzoli. Kapo ni ng'ato Synix ka ok oloki e yo ma ne ok ochan, inyalo ndiko weche moler, dirisa, kod dhok miyiero.

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Open Settings → Privacy & Security kapok ipogo picha kata inono yore mag rito weche.
Ranyisi mar Ng'ato ka Ng'ato Masks mag Privacy Mode ne nyalo nyiso gik moko e yo mayot, kaka adres kod weche migeno. Ok olok IP mar ji duto, ok oket weche e yor sirkal, kata ok ogeng'e weche duto motudore gi tuke.
Ne picha moro kapok ipogo kode. Kapo ni ng'ato oketo weche moko e pap moro, onyalo keto weche duto e pap.
WECHE MA MUMA WACHO GIMA JI NOYUDORE Synix geng'o weche motelo ma orit, kod webhook mag jal ma tiyo gi Windows sani. Tugo pod nyalo dwaro weche ma ng'ato nyalo somo e chenro mare owuon kata weche mag chako.
Kopi mar folda ma ok oket e achiel kuom ohala mamoko mag Windows ok nyal miyo ng'ato thuolo mar gonyo ohala. Ti gi chenro mar tiyo gi kodhi mondo ikony ng'ato oyud thuolo mar tudore kode.
GIMA JOKRISTO NYASAYE OYIEGO Ti gi Synix kod masinde mamoko mag tuke ma nigi ratiro mar Windows. jatelo moro kata jatelono mar tuke nyalo kwayo ni mondo ogolgi malo achiel kachiel; ok en gima owinjore mondo ng'ato oti gi gik moko duto kaka jarit.
Chenro mag rito ler mar ohinga mar geng'o tuoche ne siro chike machon mag Synix. Non ane chike moketi kapok oyiero mar golo chikno. Ok oti gi folda moro amora modwaro kendo ok oyienwa golo chike mag ohinga mar geng'o weche.
Kapo ni ng'ato ofwenyo wach moro mopondo, onego okaw okang' mar maye kar mano kata ogole oko e ofis ma ne ochiwe. Pando puodho kata golo kopi mar Synix ok nyal ketho nyingno kuonde mamoko.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Tiyo gi yo mopogore opogore e tieko windows mag nyithindo, ketho Synix, kod weyo tiyo gi app. Non ane kaka itimo gik moko kod kaka inyalo wuok.
WACHO GIMA JOKETO JOKET Synix nyalo ng'eyo chenro mag server ma pod itiyogo kendo onyalo kawo mwandugi. We mondo oketh chenro mokwongo mar timo nonro kapok ichako tiyo gi ranyisi machielo.
Ng'eyo yo mar timo gik moko onego otudre gi gima iserito, to ok mana nying ma ng'ato ong'eyo maber. Weche molos e yo mochanore owuon kata tije ma itimo koa oko nyalo dwaro ni oket pachgi ahinya.
GIMA MUMA CHIWO Rieyo gik moko e yo ma ok owinjore Windows Nyis ni idonjo. Ok ochuno ni nyaka gitim tijni mokwongo.
Tije ma ichano dwarore ni oti gi chenro mar Synix kata gima ochuno e timo tijno, nitie chenro mar Windows, kod kompyuta moting'o seche mag nindo. Kido mar chako tiyo gi masin ok nyis ni tijno biro dhi nyime ka masin osedok chien.
Kapok Ochako Kendo Ti gi gik moko e yo makare, igoyogi, kendo ilokogi. We mondo tuke odonj e Synix mondo girit kaka dwarore, kae to wuog oko kata chak Windows kendo.
Kik ipar ni kompyuta mopondo osetieko tiyo kata ni ka ichiko wang'e, to mano biro miyo otiek tugo. Non dashboard kendo iti gi gik ma chiko ngima ng'ato.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Yie mondo iyud gima ok ochuno ni itim. Kinde mar dhi nyime ma Synix oting'o ok nyal kawo kar dwaro mopogore opogore mag tuke.
WECHE MAG WACHO Ketho ma nyiso ni MSVCP140.dll kata VCRUNTIME140.dll en gima dwarore ahinya e Visual C++. Ti gi weche ma ipuonjori e tuke kod Microsoft.
Weche ma Microsoft nyalo pogo: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Kik igol DLL mopogore opogore e websait maok ochan kata kik iket DLL maok otudore gi mano machiegni gi gima inyalo ti godo mar server.
Gik mamoko madwarore Tugo moro nyalo dwaro ni ng'ato obed gi otas moro, ratiro mar tiyo gi server, kinde ma Java tiyoe, gima Windows nyalo timo, kata oti gi masindno. Chop gik ma idwaro kapok itimo lokruok e dho wath maok otudore kata ka pok itimo lokruok e yo mitimogo lokruok.
Kuom Minecraft Java, ti gi pogruok mar version/loader mochung'ne Synix's selectors. Bedrock ok oti gi Java.
Ka idwaro tiyo gi Hyper-V kata tiyo gi masindno e yo mayot, ne ni itimo nonro mar bedo moikore ne tuke. Kik iyie gi weche mag chenro kata tiyo gi server moro amora kaka jarit mana mondo kik inyis ng'ato siem.
Bang' keto gima idwaro, chak timo gimoro manyien kae to inon ane kethruok mokwongo maduong' mar game log kapo ni ok ochopo.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
THOKO MA MUMA CHUNYORE:
1. Synix yawo Space Engineers Official Dedicated Server Manager kendo kinde duto oritone.
2. Yier 'Local/Console', yier 'Continue to server configuration', ket chenro mar server kod piny, kae to yier 'Save & start'.
3. Ti gi admin mondo iyud gik mosetimore, piny, mods, jorit, kod konzoli. Weche mag server orit e folda mar Synix mar Instance.
4. Ranyisi mar Local/Console motelo ok dwar ratiro mag jarit. Windows timo kamano.
5. Gik madwarore: .NET Framework 4.8 kata mosekalo, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 kod 2017, 6 GB mar chenro RAM, kod port UDP 27016 ma ne oyiene kokalo kuom Windows Firewall kendo ne ooro ne joluo mag Intanet.
6. Weche mag Ofis: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Ti gi puonjni sama LAN play tiyo, to tem mar wuoyo gi ji ok nyal.
KIT NG'ATO MOMIYO DHOTH MAG WACHO Router moko ok riw lwedo NAT loopback, ma bende iluongo ni hairpinning. Bedo gi tudruok e kind ot kod kama odhiye nyalo kethore kata mana ka joma odak oko nyalo riwe lwedo.
Ti gi adres mar LAN e ot kae to ipenj ng'at machielo ma tiyo gi Intanet mondo onon adresno. Kata kamano, fweny mar WAN e kompyuta kende ok nyal nyiso ni Intanet osedok chien.
GIMA MUMA WACHO E KINDEGI Ok Nyal Nyiso Pogruok Non ane ka nitie router machielo ma dhi nyime, NAT mar nyadiriyo, kata NAT mar jatuwo (CGNAT). Pim weche manie WAN mar router gi adres mar sirkal kae to ipenj ISP kabe nitie tudruok mantie.
Puonj mar oro wach e router ok nyal yawo NAT ma ISP chiko. Kaluwore gi tudruokno, nyalo dwarore ni obed gi adres mar ji duto, VPN/tunnel mowinjore, kata server mochung'. Mago gin chenro mag oko to ok gin kido mag Synix.
Kik iketh chenro mar tich gi thuolo mar yudo weche mag tuke Ng'ato nyalo bedo gi tudruok gi jatuo e yor ng'ado bura gi thuolono. Ka itiyo gi weche mag API kata Discord, mano ok nyis ni inyalo yudo tuke e Intanet.
Ket chenro moro amora mar timo nonro e Intanet mondo obed machiegni gi chike koda chike mag tuke. Sama ikwayo kony, kik inyis ng'ato weche moting'o weche mopondo, tokens, piche mag router, kata weche mamoko ma nyiso ni itiyo gi intanet.

TICH MAR SYNIX Gik mitimo & Diagnostics nyiso dongruok kod siem madwarore ne joma tiyogo e dashboard. golo mana ote ma nenore kende; ok otiek weche duto mag nonro mosekano.
MACHON MA GIMA WACHO Synix ndiko mag weche kod ripot mag masiche makelo hinyruok ma ok nyal geng'o ng'ato: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Dwol mar tudruok nyalo bedo gi nying moro. Ti gi yorno kod sa ma ne ok iyudoe weche motudore kode.
Weche mag thieth ma ok nyal geng'o, inyalo ndik e gaset mar weche maok ondik e dashboard. Kata kamano, ka ng'ato oketo ranyisi mar gima ne otimoreno, mano ok nyis ni ne otimo richo moro.
LEMBE mag Tugo Ti gi log mar tuke ma ne itiyogo mondo iyud weche ma nyalo miyo ng'ato odonj e program, oti gi mod, kod weche ma nyalo miyo ng'ato odonj e program. Kama entie otenore kuom tugono kendo onyalo bedo oko mar mise.
SOMIYO WACHO Non ane gima ne otimoreno kod kaka ne ochopo, kae to inon ane weche ma ne ondik e wi kethruok mokwongo. Ng'ado mar weyo tiyo ne Jehova e giko nyalo bedo gima kelo chandruok to ok gima kelone chandruok.
Kapok ipogo weche moko, gol weche moting'o weche motelo, tokens, webhooks, adres mag ng'ato owuon, kod yorego. Console/log mar Satisfactory owuon nyalo bedo gi token mar admin. Ket weche ma ne okorgo mondo inonri iwuon.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Duoko kuonde mokethore nyalo kawo kar weche mag server moyier. Yier server mowinjore kendo ket gimoro amora manyien kapok idhi nyime.
1. Geng'o server kae to itim kopi mopogore mar fail ma nyalo dwarore. 2. Wuo gi yore mag tich mar Duoko gik moko tenge e Server Options. 3. Yier kama idwaro ketoe kalatese mag kalatese kendo inon weche motudore gi server, tarik, duong' mar kalatesego, kod chal margi. 4. Tim nonro kapok ichako. Synix backups kod SHA-256 receipts inyalo pim gi receiptsgo; Gik machon nyalo bedo gikeni. 5. Som weche ma nyiso ni idwaro kawo kar ng'at machielo kendo iyie mana ka mano e kama idwaro yudoe ngima. 6. We mondo chenro mar loso gik moko e yo mopogore opogore kod loso gik moko e yo manyien otiek ka ok ichungo Synix kata weyo kano gik moko oko. 7. Chak server kendo iyie ni piny ma idwaro kod gik midwaro.
GIMA JARITO NENO Ka ng'ato otimo nonro mar adier, onyalo fwenyo lokruoge moko motudore gi kweno. Ok onyis ni piny ne nigi ngima maber ka ne orese kata ni gik ma ng'at machielo osendiko nyalo miyo ng'ato ogenogi.
Kapo ni JARUTO OGOL Ket kalatese duto kaachiel gi weche mamoko ma inyalo dwok chien. Som ote mar duoko gik moko oko kapok item tiyo gi yo machielo mar duoko gik moko oko.
Kik igol ZIP e server ma tiyo. Kapo ni tugono siko ka kano weche oko mar folda mar keto gik moko, dwokgi e yo mopogore kaluwore gi kaka tugono konyo.
Ket weche ma nokorgo nyaka item tiyo gi server ma ne idwoko kod tudruok mar jatichno.

data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
Import Existing Server ndiko chenro mar loso gik moko ma oseket e diski. Mano ok en keto kendo opogore gi golo paket mar Synix.
Kapok Igoyo Tim backups mopogore, moriwo nyaka weche duto ma ok ni e folder mar keto gik moko. Geng'o server kendo gengo maneja machielo kata jakanyo mar chenro manyalo chako tijno ka Synix tayo tijno.
KINDE MACHON 1. Yier Add Server → Import Existing Server. 2. Yier folda mar keto server, to ok yo machuok, fail mar ZIP, kata folda mar game-client. 3. We Synix onon kode, kae to iyie gi tuke ma ne ofweny, gocho, gima inyalo tiyoe, kod kuonde mitimoe lokruok. 4. Chiw nying moro makende kendo pong'uru gik moko duto ma onge. 5. Tiek kopo, ilok Configure, kendo inon yorene kod kuonde ma idhiye. 6. Tim ikruok, kae to itim chakruok achiel. Tem neno ni piny ma idwaro kod kaka itime ne oting'o gik moko.
GIN MANG'ENO MA LOKO Riwruok mar register ok nyal golo gik moko, gologi kendo, kata kawo kar gik mamoko. Timbe ma ibiro timo bang'e, kaka Update, Validate, kata konyo kuonde mitimoe lokruok, nyalo loko faile.
Ok nyal fweny gik moko duto motudore gi tijni, kaka modpacks, passwords, kod weche ma ok oket oko. Yo achielno ok nyal ndiki diriyo.
Kapo ni JONONENO ok nyal fwenyo Tem neno ni iyiero chenro mar tiyo gi server moyier ma inyalo tigo e timo nonro. Kik ilok nying ng'at ma ok ni e achiel gi ng'at machielo mondo omi ichak kode. Nyis ni ineno tugono kaachiel gi weche moko molos mondo okony ng'eyo tiendgi.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Ti gi puonjni sama editor mar chano weche nyiso ni nitie kama itiyogo e locho, gimoro ma ok nikare, kata gima ok owinjore gi template.
Ng'e Yiero Mitiyo • Weche modhi nyime ma ok nyal geng'o gik moko duto e yo mayot. • Konyo tiyo gi weche ma nyiso ni nitie chandruok moro. • Keto kendo dwoko weche ma ne ok ochan chon e template kendo onyalo golo kuonde mitimoe lokruok.
Resipo ok e okang' mokwongo mar ketho server moro amora. Kata kamano, ok nyal geng'o gik ma ok ochuno ni gitim, kuonde ma gidhiye, kod modi ma okethore ka gitiyo gi weche mopogore opogore.
Kapok Watieko Loso We tugono, ket kopi mar fail ma ok okethore, kendo som lokruok moketi. Moko kuom profils nigi template duto; Jomoko to nyalo geno ni tugono biro loso fail e chakruok kata nyaka gitim tijno gi lwetgi.
Synix chiwo ripot ni nitie weche moko ma ok ochuno e wi weche moting'o weche mopogore opogore, kar paro ni onyalo loko weche duto e yo makare. Tiyo gi lokruok mar template ma itiyogo nyalo rito kopi achiel kende miluongo ni .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
Bang' Ka Ng'ato Ok Osechoko Kata Gosechango Ket weche mag loko kata dwoko piny kae to isom ote mar dwoko piny. Ka pok iyiero gima idwaro duoko, inyalo pimo gik ma ne itimo chon kod gik ma ne itimo sani. Kik iketh gik ma nyiso ni in ng'at maok kare kuom temo tiyo gi Reset.
Bang' ka osechango, chak ane kendo ne buk mar tuke. Tem ng'eyo ni oting'o yo makare kendo ni gik ma idwaro timo pod nitie.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune tiyo gi chenro mar tiyo gi gik moko e yore mag loyo mich kuom hawi, kendo otiyo gi masinde mag lweny. Ok en masira mar tugo tuke ma tiyo gi gimoro achiel.
Gik Madwarore Som chenro mag Synix mar timo nonro kuom weche mag paro, AVX2, hardware virtualization, Hyper-V, kod weche mag Professional kata mag Windows. Dwarore ni ng'ato obed gi paro kaluwore gi grup mar lweny kod map mibiro tiyogo.
Synix ok nyal miyo ng'ato obed gi nyalo mar timo virtual kata keto Hyper-V. Chop weche duto motudore gi tugono kapok itimo tijno.
TEGO kendo chako tijni 1. Tim chenro mar Dune: Awakening kendo ne gik ma idwaro kod kuonde mitiegoe. 2. Ket kendo chak. 3. Synix chako tich mar battlegroup.bat e yo ma sirkal dwaro. 4. Yier initial-setup e gige timo tuke kae to ichiw tokeni mar Self-Host. 5. Chop chenro mar VM, network, kod grup mar lweny e yorno.
Yudo Token mar Self-Host kokalo kuom websait mar Funcom ka itiyo gi chenro mar bedo gi ratiro mar dhi nyime: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Kik iket fwenyno e pach ji. Tiyo gi yorno ok nyis ni jorit duto mag Synix onego oti kaka jarit.
RECHE MA NITIE E KIT NG'OTE MAG WECHE MA NITIE E KIT NG'OTE MACHON Ti gi chenro mar websait mar host/VM kod port madwarore. Riwruok mar weche manie Synix ochung'ne RMQ to ok A2S.
Ok wanyal wacho ni masindego ne ochung'. Nyis ni itiyo gi weche ma nyiso ni itiyo gi gik ma itiyogo e lweny.
Synix nyalo keto, medo, chako, kendo timo backups mar folda moyier. Kik ipar ni ng'ato ka ng'ato nyalo tieko tijno, penjo jatuwo, kata kawo okang' mar chango ng'at motang' gi gik ma timore oko. Oganda ok nyal tiyo gi weche ma kamago.
Tiyo gi yore mag tieko tuke kod timo backups e weche mag VM/database. ZIP kende ok en gima inyalo tigo e timo backup.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Sulani oting'o weche mag joma osetiyo gi teknoloji kod joma ochiwore. Ok ochuno ni ibed gi gige timo dongruok mondo ichak server ka itiyo gi profil.
KAKA RECHE Tiyo Weche moting'o weche mag tuke lero downloads, executables, Steam AppIDs kod dwaro mag donjo, argumente mag chako, port, tim mar chano gik moko, gik mochuno, kod nyalo mag jorit.
Tiyo gi weche ma luwogi nyalo konyo ng'ato mondo obed gi paro mowinjore. Ok ginyal ting'o gik moko e yo ma ok owinjore, kata loso gik moko kanyachiel, kata golo weche manie Muma. Ka oketo fail mar JSON e folda mar application moseket, mano ok kel ne ng'ato weche manyien mag tuke.
Rieyo Koso Miyo Ng'ato Duogo 1. Chak gi weche ma sirkande mag Joneno mag Jehova wacho kod gik ma gitiyogo e loso program. 2. Ti gi yore motudore gi chakruok mar server kama dwarore, kendo iti gi ranyisi mag tuke. 3. Ket weche duto moting'o fom e kuonde moket kare. 4. Tim lokruok mowinjore e weche mag lero tiend weche/temo mar loso gik moko/sampuli. 5. Tim nonro e wi bugno, ti gi SDK madwarore e tijno, kendo tim nonro mowinjore. 6. Tem keto gik moko, chako, chungo, kendo ritogi ka gitiyo gi tuke mag loyo mich kuom hawi kapok gichako ndiko weche.
Geno mar bedo gi chenro mar timo dongruok en gima dwarore ahinya, to ok gima dwarore ahinya mondo ng'ato ochak tiyo kode.
NG'O MA NYASAYE • UI: Okang' ma nigi kido. • ServerHandler: Jorit tuke kod riwruok mar server. • SynixEngine: Ngima mar tiyo gi app, ritruok, tiyo gi intanet, timo backups, kod rito weche. • Chenro mar loso gik moko: Tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore mag chiko gik moko, weche moting'o pach ji, kod gik ma konyo e loso gik moko. • Database/GameDefinitions: Profiles kod template mag tuke. • Database/ModSystems: Tiyo gi yore mag tich. • Localization: Interface catalogs kod generators. • Nonro: Nonro motudore gi kido.
Sama iloko Muma e dhok mamoko, ket weche duto manie dhokgo obed manyien kendo iket tong'. Gigo oriwo weche ma nyalo konyo, nonro ma inyalo tim, ndiko ma nyalo konyo ng'ato mondo oyud weche momedore, kod weche malero kaka inyalo tigo e loso tuke. Kik ilok chike, tigo, tokens, nengo mag joma tiyogo, kata weche ma nyiso ni ng'ato ong'eyo gima owuokgo. Weche ma nondik chon ok lokre.
Som weche mag License & Proprietary before redistributing code or builds. Kik iket weche mag ng'eyo gik ma itimo kendo kik iket weche mag ng'eyo gik ma itimo.
