data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Ket chenro mar rito server mana bang' temo timne mar backup, update, stop, kod start.
1. Yaw chenro mar timo tijni gi tijno kendo iyie gi tijno. 2. Yier odiechieng' kod sa. 3. Ti gi Smart Maintenance kendo yier yore mag timo backup/update. 4. Yier kabe ibiro rito jotugo kae to iket thuolo mar dhi nyime. 5. Ket kendo item timo nonro e kinde ma inyalo rito gik moko.
Chenrono tiyo gi seche mag kompyuta. Ket seche kod kuonde ma itimee gik moko kare.
Sama Ng'ato Chako Lendo e Yo Mowinjore Synix nyalo rito joluo motudore, kae to oriw lwedo tij chungo grup mar chenro ma oserum, timo backups ka ichung', medo kendo chako kendo kaluwore gi yore moyier.
Kinde ma ng'ato nyalo kawo en mana sa achiel kende, to ok singruok mar rito nyaka chieng'. Tiego nyalo dhi nyime ka otieko kata kapo ni jokedo pod odong'. Bedo maonge kinde mar rito ok nyal miyo ng'ato odok chien.
Weche mag JATIMO nigi tong ' Warruok biro luwore gi weche ma tuke moyiergo nyalo chiwo. Sewer mar API moting'o tudruok gi Satisfactory timo nonro kuom kwan machon kata ma ok yudre e kinde mar rito. Mano ok nyis ni inyalo gen weche ma ng'ato dwaro.
Nyis jotugo wachno motelo kendo isom ote mag gik mitimo. Discord nyalo chiwo ripot kuom gik ma timore e rito kuonde mitimoe ritruok ka gitiyo gi yoregi.
PC nyaka bed motang' kendo chenro mar Synix kata ng'at mochung'ne weche nyaka ti. Kompyuta ma ok nyal tiyo kata ma nindo, ok nyal timo download kod chako kendo.

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Yaw Windows Terminal kata PowerShell kae to iti gi ranyisi mar pak ma yudore piny kae. Wechegi tayo Synix kende, to ok server mag tuke.
TEGO winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
TEM ANE KINDE MACHON winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
WECHE MA MUMA Geng' Synix kendo tiek tich ma itimo kapok itiyo gi: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
TEG KIT MANYALO TEGO winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Bed gi Rieko Tigo mag server, chiwo weche, kod timo backups opogore gi chenro mar application. Kik igol C:\Synix kata folda moro amora mar data mak mana ka idwaro golo wechego goyiem.
Kapo ni Chik Ok Nyal Chopo Som ane gimomiyo nonego otim kamano. Ka WinGet onyiso ni ng'ato ok nyal tiyo gi hash mar installer, weye kendo inyise wachno; kik iketh ng'eyo mar hash. Kapo ni ng'ato onge gi weche manyien, mano nyalo nyiso ni ok osetiyo gi gaset manyien.
Yie mar WinGet kod hash mar download ma luwore gi mano ok nyis ni Synix en kodhi kata ok onyis ni program mar sirkal mar Windows biro gene.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Mokwongo nyaka inyis ni tugono tiyo e intanet mari. Loko mar router ok nyal rieyo tuke ma pok ochako kata otieko chungo.
Yier Yo Maber mar Lendo • E kompyuta mar server: Ti gi tudruok ma itiyogo e tuke. • E kompyuta machielo: Ti gi adres mar LAN mar kompyuta. • Ka ok itiyo gi intanet: Ti gi adres ma in-go e nyim ji duto kata tiyo gi yore mag yudo gik ma igolo e tuke.
Tim nonro e wi weche moting'o weche motudore gi tudruok. Adresa mar LAN ok nyal tigo achiel kachiel gi joluo mag Intanet.
TEST E PINY 1. Warit mondo tugono orum. 2. Non kikombe molos kod gik ma nyiso ni jatichno oikore. 3. Winjri gi achiel kuom kompyuta makonyo, kae to itime kamano e wi LAN machielo. 4. Kapo ni ng'ato ok nyal tiyo gi LAN, ne ane weche mag tuke kod Windows Firewall.
Weuru Joluo e Intanet 1. Chiw adres mar LAN mosiko ne wuon ot, ma kinde mang'eny oting'o DHCP mar router. 2. Nyisuru kuonde ma idhiye kod protocol mag TCP/UDP ma dwarore mondo otigo e loso tuke. 3. Ket mana kuondego e adres mar LAN mar wuon ot. 4. We mondo tugni mag tuke ochop e Windows Firewall e Intanet ma itiyogo. 5. Nonro ma ne otim kuom tudruok gi Intanet mopogore.
Kik iket router mar DMZ, kik igeng' ohinga mar lweny, kata kik inyis ni dho wath moro amora mar sirkal en gima ok owinjore. Ket weche mag router obed maling'ling'.
Synix en maneja mar desktop. Mano ok oriwo web panel kata public relay ma miyo dwaro mag netego lal.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD golo kendo timoga dongruok e weche mag server mochiw ne tuke mag Steam. Synix loso kopi mare modol e yo mayot; ok ochuno ni ng'ato obed gi tab mopogore mar SteamCMD.
Dhi Nyime Lendo Yier server kendo som Activity & Diagnostics. Gik ma timore e dashboard nyiso ni tich mitimo sani dhi nyime. SteamCMD nyalo lokore e kind golo gik moko, pogo gik moko, gonyo gik moko, kod yie kodgi, omiyo ok en kinde duto ma onyalo chiwo pasent maok lokre kata seche ma odong'.
We tich mar disk otiek kata kapo ni ohala mar intanet odok piny. Som ote mogik ma nyiso ni ne itimo gimoro maber kata marach kapok ichako tich machielo.
RECHE mar Golo Weche Manie Intanet Open Settings → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Yier mode moting'o gik moko duto kendo idonj e rate ma inyiso, kata yier mode moting'o gik moko duto.
Mano mulo download mag SteamCMD, to ok bandwidth mar jo tugo, downloader mar tuke duto maok gin mag Steam, kata traffic duto manie PC.
Dwokruok kod Ketho Moko kuom weche mag tuke dwaro ni ng'ato obed gi otis mar Steam kod Steam Guard. Ti gi ranyisi mar Synix; kik giket weche ma nyiso ng'ato ka ng'ato ni en e achiel kuom jokanyo mag riwruok mar oganda Jehova.
Mondo iyud gima ok ne giyiero, som ane kethruok mar SteamCMD kendo item nono kama thuolo nitie e disk, kama inyalo yudoe folda, kama inyalo yudoe Intanet, kod gik mamoko ma dwarore mondo ng'ato otigo gi kontimono. Weche ma nyiso ni itiyo gi weche moting'o weche makare nyalo miyo ng'ato odwok weche manie Muma e yo mayot, omiyo nyaka oket wechego e yo mowinjore kapok oti kodgi.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Scenario mag Empyrion kod mods mag code mag server opogore. E Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, yier Empyrion scenarios kata Empyrion server mods. Geng'o server kendo ikri gi weche duto kapok itimo lokruoge moko.
TEG Ranyisi 1. Browse Catalog yawo Workshop mar Steam. Ndik piny kuom siganino kendo rit mondo Steam otiek goye. Weche ma ne ochan e chokruok mar timo nonro kod gik ma ne ochan e chokruogego ne ok gin weche ma ne nyalo timore ne jorit. 2. Yier Paket mar Telo, kae to yier Folder. Yier folda moro ka moro mar weche manie bwo folda mar Steam e laibrari mar steamapps\workshop\content\383120. Bende inyalo yiero kaka inyalo tiyo gi ZIP. 3. Ket nying folder ma inyalo fwenyo. Kik iti gi ID mar Workshop kende. Ket nying folda machal kamano e kinde mabiro. 4. Non nonro mar paket kod kama idhiye, kae to ing'e ni gikelo. Synix ndiko sigendni duto e Content\Scenarios maok otigo kata loko piny moro amora. 5. Yier Scenario mondo inyis kaka inyalo tiyo gi wechego. Yier achiel kae to inon nyingno mopogore. Ka ng'ato oloko pache e yo machielo, nyaka obed gi nying manyien ma ok otigo. Synix nyiso ni nitie achiel kendo ok otudore gi weche ma ne osekonygi. 6. Tim yiero, chak tiyo gi server, kae to ing'i weche ma ne itiyogo kod tudruok mar japuonj. Moko kuom gik ma nyalo timore e ngima nyalo bedo gi weche mamoko kata dwaro mamoko ma jandiko owuon ema oketo.
Nying sigendni en GameConfig.CustomScenario; Nying piny ma ne oresogo en GameConfig.GameName. Synix timo backups mag dedicated.yaml kapok oloko kuondego kendo omako weche ma server wacho. Ok ochak oket kodhi, weche moting'o weche mitiyogo, kata gik mamoko ma ok otudore kode.
Rieyo yore mag server Ti gi Empyrion server mods profile kod Import Package mondo iyier mod ZIP molos kata mod folder. Gigo oriwo DLLs, gik makonyo, gik ma gigeno, kod _Info.yaml. Synix keto magi e bwo Content\Mods; tugono biro ting'o kodino ka ochakore. Golo kod kodhi ma wuok e dhoot kendo keto gik moko tenge ok nyalre.
Synix ok ti gi mod loader kata tiyo gi mod mod ma ok nyal tiyo. Luw chike mag jandiko, moriwo koda weche mamoko ma nyalo miyo ng'ato oting'e gik moko, kaka chenro, kod chenro mar tich. Tiyo gi modgo e yo maber ok nyis ni modgo owinjore gi game masani kata mod mamoko moseket.
WECHE MA WACHO KA WACHO Steam update its Workshop copy, not the server copy imported by Synix. Mondo imed timo lokruok, chung' server kendo igol paket manyien kitiyo gi nying folder ma chal kamano. Non ane ka be jandik - gasedno dwaro ni ores ng'ato manyien. Fichego ma oket kargi yudo kopi mag gik moket oko; golo weche manyien ok en keto gik moko e yo maler kendo ok otiekgo weche ma onge e paket manyien.
Giko weche duto moting'o gik moko, to ok gik moko duto moting'o mwandu. Ne oket (ok ne oket manyien) tiende en ni ne oket weche ma ne ouso, to ok ni ne oket gik moko duto ma ne oket manyien. Roll Back Import golo gik moko duto ma oseyierogo, moriwo modi mamoko manie paket achielno, kendo otamore loko faile ma ne oloki oko mar Synix. Scenario moyier kod mwandu mag scenario madwarore mondo piny ores kik kethre; Kata kamano, weche ma ne okorgo pod inyalo dwok e fise machon.

data.name: Content.9C9046B6659057C8B0D0
data.value: ● TELEMETRY MA BEDO

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Open Configure → Network & RCON mondo inon gik ma itiyogo e tuke moyier. Ti gi kaka tugono ochanore, to ok kitiyo gi chike machuok.
RONGO mag dho wath • Migawo mar tugono: Riwruok mar jogo. • Port mar penjo: Puonj mag server kata fwenyruok, kapo ni sirkal mar penjo pod siro wachno. • RCON/admin port: Kanal mar admin ma ok oyier. • Port mar App/API: Jal mitimo kanyachiel gi jogo kata jal matayo jogo.
TCP kod UDP gin chike mopogore opogore. Pwod aryo mapat pat twero tic ki namba acel-lu, ento lutit kwena aryo pe gitwero nywako lok ma rwatte. Synix bende nono profils okan kuom sandruok mar port, moriwo nyaka weche ma ok odonj.
Ket weche mag giko ma ne otigo mondo obed makende e kinde mopogore opogore kendo rit tudruok moro amora madwarore e tuke e kind okenge. Kik ipar ni weche duto mitimogo tugono gin mag UDP kata ni kama itime penjo moro amora ochung'ne ng'at ma winjo.
JARITO Ok Tim Tuke Kuom ranyisi, jotugo ok dwar yudo RCON kata kuonde mamoko mag admin. Ket chenro mar sirkal e kar kendi, mak mana ka in gi chenro mar sirkal moting'o weche mag sirkal.
Ranyisi Makende mag Tugo • Minecraft Java kod Bedrock tiyo gi timbe mopogore opogore mag tudruok; Luw sula moyier. • Satisfactory mar API tiyo gi port mar game/API molos; ok en gima dwarore ahinya ne Synix. • Dune's query-field metadata ochung'ne RMQ deployment port, to ok Steam A2S query service. • Rust+ bende tiyo gi weche mamoko mopogore gi mag tuke.
Weche ma ok ochan e template gin weche mag chakruok, to ok list mar ng'ado bura mar tiyo gi router. Non ane ng'at ma winjo ka pok iloko chik mar ohinga.

data.value: Dune: Awakening tiyo gi sirkal mar server. Hyper-V kod hardware virtualization nyaka bed ni otiyo, kendo Windows Pro kata Enterprise dwarore. E kinde ma ikwongo goye, Synix chako battlegroup.bat kaka Jaloch. Yier initial-setup kendo ikri gi tokeni mar Self-Host. Synix nyalo keto, medo timo lokruok, timo backups, kendo chako tij lendo, to kata kamano, tugono nigi masinde mag kompyuta kod kaka gitiyo. Puonj mar Ofis: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.value:
Webhooks mag Discord oro gik ma notimore ne server e channel moro. Gigo gin siem, to ok Discord bot mar chiko Synix gi kuma bor.
Ket Chenro 1. Tim kata iyud webhook mar channel ma in gi ratiro mar lochoe. 2. Open page Configure → Discord mar server moyier. 3. Donji e webhook kendo yier yore ma inyalo tiyogo e loso gik matimore. 4. Ket chenro. 5. Ti gi tim mar timo nonro kapo ni ochiwgi, kata iyie gi chiwo e kinde ma itimoe chenro.
Weche mag chako, tieko tijno, dwoko, timo backups, kod rito tijno otenore kuom yore ma ne otigo kendo kabe tijno ne otimore adier.
KINDE MACHON URL mar webhook oting'o weche mag ndiko. Ng'ato ang'ata mong'eyo nyalo oro ote e yorno. Kik iket wechego e piche ma ji ng'iyo, weche ma igoyo, kata wuoyo kodgi.
Synix geng'o webhook ma ne oketo mondo otigo gi Windows. Kapo ni URL osenenore, lokne kata gol kode e Discord, kae to ipwodhe Synixen e kama odhiye. Non nying' mag server kod weche motudore gi gima ne otimoreno ma ne oor ne channel moro.
Kapo ni Weche Ok Bi Non ane yo ma ne iyiero mar timoreno, URL, channel/webhook, kod kabe PC nyalo chopo Discord. Non ane kethruok ma ne onyisno maok ilando URL duto.
Riwruok mar Discord tiyo gi riwruok ma dhi wuok. Ok ochuno ni mondo ng'ato oyaw dho wath mar chiko router.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Ng'e kabe ibiro golo mana dashboard kende, koso ibiro gonyoga bende server misetiyogo. Mago gin gik mopogore opogore.
Golo mana app kende 1. Ti gi chenro moro amora mar keto gik moko e kompyuta, tiyo kodgi e yo machielo, kata timo backup. 2. Geng'o serverni e Synix, rit mondo gitiek choko kendo wuok e Synix. 3. Bed gi kopi mar gik ma dwarore ahinya e piny, weche moting'o gik moko, kod weche migeno. 4. Gonyo Synix kokalo kuom Windows Apps miseketo kata japuonj paket mari.
Ket C:\Synix, folda mag server modimbore, kuonde ma igoloe tuke mag ot, kod kuonde ma idhiye ka idwaro tiyo kodgi kendo. Ka idwaro keto app manyien, ok ochuno ni nyaka ilog foldago.
GOL Achiel kuom Jokanyo mag Websaitwa Ti gi tich mar Delete mar server moyier e Synix kendo isom weche ma nyiso ni itimo kamano. Golo weche manie dashboard ok en gima chalre gi yie golo fail mag loso gik moko kata timo backups. Non ane adimba weche ma ibiro gol oko.
Kik iti gi gologi kaka yo machuok mar tieko chandruok. Backup ma okan mana ei folda midwaro tieko ok en kopi mar resruok.
Kapo ni idonjo e panel machielo mar chiko, tem neno ni onyalo chako keto gik moko e yo makare kendo iko piny miseng'ado kapok igolo weche machon.

Be Wach SYNIX en Wach Manyien? Open First Time Setup Guide e Getting Started & Setup.
BE INYALO tiyo gi server moro? Yier migawo ma idwaro timo, kaka keto chenro mar tich, tiyo gi intanet, timo backups, kata tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore mag loyo mich.
Dwaro Richo? Kitiyo gi Press Ctrl+F, kendo imany gimoro, tuke, kata weche machuok e ote. Ka itiyo gi yor manyo weche, inono weche manie sula kod weche duto motudore gi wechego.
Ti gi baton mar Clear-search mondo idog e sula duto. Golo kendo siro tudruok ma inyalo yudo e browser mana ka iyierogi.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Yier server kendo iti gi gige timo nonro mar tudruok kata gige timo tuke sama gintie. Synix yiero cheki kaluwore gi penjo mar tuke, TCP/UDP/HTTP, local API, kod nyalo mar timo gik moko.
GIMOMIYO WACHO Dwoko mar tudruok matin ok nyis ni ng'ato nyalo nyiso ni en jaadiera kendo onyalo riwore kode. Kata kamano, tiyo gi yorno bende ok nyis ni tij manyo dwoko mar penjono osechopo.
Kwan mar jogo koda nyingegi gin gik mopogore opogore. Server nyalo chiwo ripot mar jogo mang'eny motudore maok onyiso nying ' moro amora. Ng'at ma onge ng'ato e kwano ok en ng'at ma ong'eyo ni onge ng'at moromogo.
OSAYE MA WACHORE Moko kuom yore mag EOS kende kata mar crossplay ok nyis ni nitie penjo ma inyalo gen kata yo ma inyalo tigo e locho gi joluo. Synix nyalo nyiso N/A kata weyo nono tem kar nyiso gima kelo wuond.
Non ane e yo ma oyierogo gaset mar Minecraft kod chenro mar loyo gasedno. Kwan mar joluo mag Satisfactory otenore kuom tudruok margi gi API. Kik ichak tiyo gi weche mag EOS ma nyalo konyo mana josayans kende e timo nonro.
MACHON MA NITIE E SERVER Ng'eny tuke mag Steam tiyo gi penjo mag A2S, kata kamano mano ok en gima timore e piny mangima. Riwruok, keto tuke, koda tiyo gi browser nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi thuolo mar neno gik moko, kendo onge kinde sie ma ng'ato nyalo ketoe weche.
Kapo ni server onge e browser, tem ane tiyo gi yo ma tugono tudorego kode achiel kachiel kae to inon weche manie gochoni. Loko dhoudi mag penjo maok nie tudruok nyadinwoya nyalo kelo pek mamoko.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Ti gi Configure mar kuonde ma Synix lochoe. Ti gi editor mar Configuration-file e Server Options sama idwaro nono kata loko kaka tugono chalo.
1. We server kik ti ka osomo failno sama ochako kata ka ochako ndikone kendo sama otiyo. 2. Tim backup kendo iyie gi server kod fail miyiero. 3. Som weche manie iye kod paro ma ji chiwo. 4. Lok mana gik midwaro loko. 5. Rieyo weche ma jandiko wacho ni ok gin adier, kendo nono siemgo. 6. Ket, chak server kokalo kuom Synix, kendo ne weche manyien mag tuke.
DHOK MA Gichung'e Synix chiwo yo mar tiyo gi fom mochanore maber ne INI/properties, JSON, XML, YAML, kod yore mamoko motudore gi profil. Ok ni gik moko duto moting'o fail kata yo ma ginyalo tiyogo gin gi jarit molony. YAML modich siro kuonde moket, kuonde ma ondik weche, kod kuonde ma ondik weche moting'o weche. Ng'eny YAML gik moko kaka anchors, aliases, inline collections, kod multiline values ibiro tam maok orito.
Ket weche moting'o weche, gik ma iyiego, map mag piny, kod chike mana kaka tugono dwaro. Kik ilokgi mondo giwinjre gi dhok ma itiyogo.
NYASAYE MA NYASAYE OYIEGO Kata kamano, nitie kuonde ma ok owinjore gi weche manie Muma. Mods kata weche manyien mag tuke nyalo medo gik moko ma jarit ok ong'eyo. Tem neno ni tugono ne oting'o gik moko duto ma ne idwaro timo bang ' chako kendo.
Kapo ni jagoro machielo kata tugono oloko failno ka oting'o weche duto, ket kendo pim kode kapok irese. Dhok mag tuke nyalo oting'o weche moting'o weche mitiyogo e somo kata tokens; non kendo ilergi kapok ichiwogi.
Satisfactory's live API options belong to its Control Center and are separate from editing its on-disk configuration files.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Yier Configure for an existing server, kata ti gi pawni mar setting sama ichako achiel. Lok mana kuonde mitimoe tuke.
Yore mag Chakruok kod Medo Dongruok Yo mar chako lendo jiwo gik ma ji ohero timo kod chike ma gichiwo. Ranyisi mar Advanced mode nyiso chike mamoko mag tiegruok, moriwo nyaka RCON ma siro kod yore mag chako tiyo gi masinde. Tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore ok mi ng'ato keth nengo ma oresogo. Weche mag Discord yudore e yore ariyogo.
GIN MA NG'ATO KA NG'ATO NENO • Weche duto: Nying' server, tuke, gocho/dwoko, kod yiero weche mag tugo tuke. • Sirkal: Weche moting'o weche moting'o paro kod gik mamoko ma nyalo miyo ng'ato oyud thuolo mar tiyo gi modno. • Tieng' mar Piny: Nying' piny, kodhi, duong', koda yore ma inyalo tigo e piny. • Network & RCON: Tiyo gi weche mag tuke, penjo, osiepe/API, kod weche mag loch. • Tiyo gi yore mag ritruok: Backup/update-on-start kod rito gik moko e yo mochanore. • Discord: Migawo mag lendo kod chenro mar chenrono. • Keto & Tugo: Folda mar keto kod yore mag chako.
Puothe ma ok nyal tiyo e tuke mag loyo mich kuom hawi gin mag ratiro. Ng'ato nyalo bedo gi chenro mar timo kamano owuon kata onyalo bedo maonge kony moro amora; keto weche momedore e chik ok en gima yot.
TEMBE ANG'ENO mag Nono Weche mag server → Gik madwarore → Nonro → Konyo server
Gigo nyiso ni giketo pachgi duto e yo mowinjore, to ok gitim download kata keto gik moko e yo maber. Bang ' ka gik ma idwaro osetimore, Synix biro yawo okang ' mar 3 mondo omi inon yiero misetimo, kae to igollo Save Server. Loko chenro mar loko lokore kendo Save until the updated choices are shown in Review. Nyaka iyier mar reso ngimani; sama ichako somo Muma, ok inyal kano weche e yo mayot. Som weche ma yudore e tiende ka gimoro dwaro ni ng'ato oket pache kuome.
Sama iloso server moro, weye odonjne mokwongo kapo ni lokruogno mulo fail kata yiero ma isomo ka ichako. Save Changes oloso profil mare; ok onyis ni ng'ato osetiyo gi gigo. Chak kendo tiyo gi Synix sama tugono dwaro.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Open Configure → Automation mondo server moyier oyier tich mabiro timore kapok ochako.
Dwokruok e Chakruok Miye thuolo mar timo kamano mondo ichak timo backups mag server ma ne oweyo kapok ochako tiyo. Ket kar chakruok kod rit e program mar Settings → Backups.
Tim mar chango masira chakore ka ng'ato ong'ado mar weyo tiyo gi yore mapile. Weche ma ok nyal geng'o gik moko mondo ochak tiyo, ok nyal kawo kar rito kuonde mag dwoko mag gik moko ka pok otim lokruok madongo.
WECHE MA NYASAYE Miye thuolo mar timo nonro mar loso weche manyien mag tuke ka pok ochak. Otimoga lokruok e weche mag game server, to ok e weche mag Synix.
Ng'eyo weche manyien ok en gima nyiso ni ng'ato ka ng'ato ma chako timo tijno biro golo fail. SteamCMD kod jang'ado tuke mag loyo mich kuom hawi yiero gima dwarore.
KINDE MA WECHE MOKWONGO JOKRISTO Tiyo gi yo machuok miluongo ni Validate nyalo konyo e loso kata golo kendo weche ma jomisonari tayo. Siro lokruok kapok otim lokruok kata ka pok otime; Kik ipar ni gik moko duto ma idwaro timo biro siko ka onge.
Tem Yiero Mitiyo Ket gik ma idwaro timo kae to iti gi chenro mar chako. Som weche ma nyiso ni itimo dongruok mondo ibed gi konyruok, timo lokruok, kendo chako tijno. Kata obedo ni tugono oserumo, mano ok nyis ni tugono osegoyo tijego e yo maber.
Weuru thuolo moromo mar timo gik moko kaka archives, downloads, fail mag kinde machuok, koda tuke miseketo. Kapo ni tijni ochakore kapok ochopo, non ane gimomiyo ne itimo kamano kar chako tiyo gi server achielno oko mar Synix mondo kik itime gimoro.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Open Ready for the selected server before its first start or when something fails. Ochoko gik ma oket e paro kaka faile, seche mag tich, chenro, kar dak mar diski, port, chal mar tich, kod weche mamoko.
NG'E GIMA MUMA BEDO • Timo ikruok: Ne ok giyudo gimoro amora ma ne nyalo geng'o ng'ato. • Non ane: Som gima oseneno kae to ing'e kabe dwarore ni itim gimoro. • Giko: Ka pok idhi nyime gi puonjruok, inyalo tieko wachno.
Bedo moikore ok nyis ni itimo lokruok moro amora. Non ane okang' moketi kod kaka osechike.
Bang ' Keto Ng'at Manyien Chakruok mokwongo nyalo golo fail, keto chenro mar tiyo, loso chenro, kendo rito mondo tugono ochak chakre. Luw weche ma nyiso kaka inyalo chako tiyo gi dashboard kod Activity & Diagnostics kar kawo weche moket e dashboard kaka tuke mochak.
Nitie tuke moko ma dwaro ni ng'ato otim singruok moro, onyis ni en adier, kata mondo oket chenro mar yudo gik moko e tuke kapok ng'ato nyalo riwore kodgi. Ti gi okang'no e yo mowinjore.
SIGAND NG'ENO mar Luwo Chik Synix oseneno weche mag Siro, Chakruok, Chungo, kod Nono. Ok oseteme kata matin, mano nyiso ni onge gima oseneno; Mano ok nyis ni ng'ato ong'eyo ni tugono okethore.
Chenro mar timo nonro e yo makare, kata timo nonro e yo maber, ok nyal miyo ng'ato obed gi thuolo mar tiyo gi intanet, bedo gi winjruok maber gi jomoko, kata bedo gi winjruok maber gi joodgi. Ti gi ranyisi ma nyiso ni ng'ato nigi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Backup mar server moyier rito fail man e folda mar serverno. Non ane kuonde ma tugono nyalo resoe piny kapok ogene.
Timuru Kanyakla 1. We server odonj e Synix kae to irito mondo tijene owuog. 2. Yier gima inyalo timo mondo ikonygo ng'ato. 3. Non ane kama idhiye, kama idhiye, kar dak ma ibiro kwanie, kod kar dak manie diski. 4. Ket wachno e paro kendo rit mondo otiek tijno. 5. Yier Open Backup Folder mondo iyud kama idhiye. Bed gi kad mar chung' motegno.
WECHE MA MUMA Backup oriwo folda mar keto gik moko, to ok folda matin mar kano gik moko. Tugo tuke madongo nyalo dwaro ni ng'ato oti gi thuolone mang'eny.
Nyalo bedo ni kuondego ok ni e folda mar AppData, Documents, drive machielo, kata masin moro mar kompyuta motudore gi tuke. Ti gi yo ma tugono.
LOCATION AND RETENTION Root mapile mar back-up en C:\Synix\BackupGames. Settings → Backups mamiyoyi thuolo mar yiero root machielo kendo keto tong' mar backups.
Kama idhiye nyaka bed oko mar folda mar server. Loko root mar backup ok nyal golo kata tieko weche manie muma; Tem ane nono kama chon ne idhiye mondo ine kuonde ma ne itimee bakup.
Tigo mar rito gik moko e yo makare golo weche machon ma ok kare sama ng'ato oketho tong' ma noketgo. Ket kuonde ma idokie chuth oko mar kama idhiye.
Ket kopi machielo mar piny madongo e kar kano weche mopogore. Disk ma ne ok otimo maber ne nyalo ketho server kod backups ma ne okan e disk achielno. ZIP mar folda mar tiyo gi weche ma oko ok en gima inyalo tigo kaka VM kata database.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Som ote mar Windows e yo makare kapok ing'ado gima idwaro loko. Gimaduong' ma nyalo miyo ng'ato oti, en ketho mar yudo fail, kod bedo gi kinde mar tugo e tuke.
SYNIX Ok Nyal Tigo Kata Yawogi Ti gi gaset ma sirkal ogolo kata WinGet pakiti ma ubidzz.Synix. Kapo ni idwaro loko fail moro, inyalo gonyo Synix kitiyo gi yorno kendo temo kendo. Non weche ma yudore e folda kod weche mag software mar sirkal ka chandruok pod dhi nyime.
Kik ilog data mar server kata kik igol sirkal mar sirkal.
Smartscreen Chenro mar chiwo siem nyalo miyo ng'ato ong'e weche momedore → Tim kamano, kaluwore gi chike mag Windows. Bedo ni mano en gima nyalore ok nyis ni oting'o fail maber. Non ane kama ondik weche ma yudore e gasedno kendo non siemno kapok ing'ado mar dhi nyime.
RECHO MAR APP mar SMART Mano nyalo geng'o app ka Windows ok nyal keto geno moromo. Kata kamano, onge program moro amora ma inyalo pim gi SmartScreen. Kik iol weche mag rito Windows mana mondo itiek Synix.
ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAIL Tim nonro e wi weche duto. Kik ipar ni siem moro en mar miriambo nikech ondikno iluongo ni Synix. Dhok mar SHA-256 ma chalre gi mano fwenyo fail ma ogol; ok ochak riwruok mar geno kata keto sei.
Nyis kaka inyalo chiwo siem kod kaka inyalo ketogi, to kik iwe weche moting'o weche moting'o pach ji. Tamri keto weche moko e yo maok owinjore kata weyo maok itimo nonro mar hash.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Ti gi Settings → Backups e loko Synix duto. Mano opogore gi ndiko folda achiel mar server.
Non ane gima onego otimre Yien maduong' mar C:\Synix ema oting'o paket mag ohala. Kata kamano, nitie kuonde mamoko ma nyalo konyo e loso weche mag kompyuta. Ndik ane yo ma gidhiye kapok gichako. Yore ma ji oheroe Windows bende nyalo dwarore ni onon e wi kama gidhiye.
WECHE MA WACHO 1. Geng'o server kendo ti gi weche mag rito gik moko, golo gik moko, kod timo backups. 2. Yier tiyo gi kodhi kata tiyo gi kodhi. 3. Yier kama idhiye oko mar yiendni miwuoyoe e sulani, kae to inon ane okang' kod gik ma dwarore kuom kar dak. 4. Ka idwaro golo gik moko e pinje mamoko, yier weche moting'o weche ma nyalo miyo ng'ato oter gik moko e piny machielo kendo iketgi e yo mopogore. 5. Rit mondo pak mar .synixbackup otiek, kae to item.
Yier Yo Maber mar Rito Ngimani Ng'ato ka ng'ato kuomwa nyalo bedo gi thuolo mar timo kamano. Windows pesa.
Ng'ato ka ng'ato ok nyal tiyo gi weche ma sirkal oketo. Weche motudore gi tuke koda weche manie iye nyalo nyiso weche mopondo. Ka ng'ato oketo weche moting'o kodok korka Windows, mano kende ok nyal miyo oti kodgi e yo machielo.
THOKO 1. Mokwongo, dwok chien weche ma yudore e Synix. 2. Yie mondo idonj e yore mag import/verification kae to iyier pak ma idwaro. 3. Chiw weche moting'o weche migolo kapo ni okwayo, kendo item ng'eyo gima oting'o. 4. Non ane kama idhiye, gik ma idwaro ni disk obedie, kendo ndik siemgo. 5. Weuru mondo otiek loso gik moko duto e yo maber, tiyo kodgi e yo maber, kendo kawo okang' mowinjore. 6. Non yore mag server, kuonde ma idhiyee, chenro mag gik mitimo, kuonde ma idhiyee kod weche migeno kapok ichako gimoro amora.
Dwok Satisfactory kendo kapo ni nying mare mar piny kata tudruokne moting'o rit koro ok chalre. Ket paket mokwongo kod weche machon nyaka chop kinde ma ibiro timie nonro mar servergo.
Weche ma ok nyal geng'o ng'ato mondo kik odonj e program mar timo nonro. Kapo ni idho kata dhi e piny machielo ok nyalre, ket kopi kod ote mar duoko oko kar kawo kar database matiyo ka Synix tiyo.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Migawo mar Siro kod Loso oting'o folda mar server moyier kaachiel gi yore mag chako. Bed gi chikno mak mana ka ing'eyo kaka tugono tiyo.
GIMA MUMA WACHO Ti gi yore mag Advanced sama dwarore ni igol weche ma ok ochan. Non ane weche moler, yore ma inyalo tiyoe, kod nying' mag yiero mitiyogo e tuke. Synix osenyiso ni nitie gik ma nyalo konyo ng'ato ka ng'ato. medo kopi machielo nyalo kelo pogruok.
Kik ilok switch kata okel kar nengo mar tekni mitimo gi weche moloki. Kik iket weche ma nyiso ni itimo gimoro mana mondo obed mayot ndikogi.
Fichni mag Wuok e Piny Mangima Kuom weche molony, Server Options → Create Batch File ndiko chik mar chako e script.
Fichego nyalo bedo gi weche moting'o weche mitiyogo e somo kata weche moting'o weche matiyo e tij lendo. Ketgi tenge kendo inongi kapok ipogogi kata idhogi.
Tiyo gi script oko mar Synix ok nyal miyo Synix duto otigo e yo maber, ok nyal miyo ng'ato obed motang', ok nyal miyo ng'ato bedo gi chenro mar rito chenrono. Kik iti kode ka Synix nigi serverno.
WECHE MA NITIE E KINDEGI Moko kuom weche mag tuke chako tiyo gi gige tich ma gin-go kar tiyo mana gi gimoro achiel. Kata kamano, nitie gik ma nyalo konyo e loso weche ma ok ochuno. Luw weche ma nyiso kaka inyalo timogi kar tiyo gi gimoro machielo.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Ti gi gaset mar golo twege. Oting'o .NET runtime madwarore kuom Synix; nyalo dwarore ni jogo ma tiyo e tuke obed gi gik mochuno.
Yier YOR MAR TEGO • MSI: Gol SynixSetup.msi, ti kode, kae to iyaw Synix Control Panel e menu mar Start. Kama itiyogo e tiyo gi app en %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Ti gi pak ma in- go.Synix. Weche moler e sula mar WinGet Installation and Updates oting'o chike. • Migawo mar timo gik moko gi tekone owuon: Ket weche ma igoyo kitiyo gi tekone owuon e folda ma inyalo ndik kae to itiyogo kanyo. Tiyo gi kompyuta ma kamano ok nyis ni koro idwaro tiyo gi server duto.
Weche ma ne ogol e Intanet: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
TEG KIT MANYALO KONYO 1. Ti gi weche mag download, back-up, kod rito gik moko. 2. Geng'i weche mag tuke mag Synix kendo gol Synix e yo makare. 3. Ti gi masin mar update kata installer e yo ma iyiero mar ketogo. 4. Yaw Synix kendo ine kabe weche miseng'ado e server kod yoregi nikare.
Ka idwaro loko program machon mar EXE gi MSI, kwong igol program machonno. Ket weche mag server kod folda mag server. Kik igol C:\Synix mondo ilos program.
Weche manyien mag app ok nyal miyo tuke ma in - go obed manyien. Ti gi weche mag Update ma server moyiero tiyogo e timo kamano.
Kapo ni Windows nyiso ni ok oyienegi donjo e programno sama ichako tiyo kode, ne ni kopi ma ibiro loko koro ok ti. Kik iket weche moko e wi program ma itiyogo kata golo weche mag server mondo kik idonj e kethono.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Synix ng'iyo teko mar resource ka pok ogolo gimoro mondo omi oketh ratiro ma bedoe mar chamo chiemo mokalo tong'. Kapo ni ichako tijni bang' kinde matin, kata ka ok itimo kamano, som wach moting'o gik mipuonjori.
Bed Maber gi Ng'at ma Welo Yie mondo ng'ato obed gi paro mar Windows kod weche ma noket e mise, kaachiel gi tuke. Bed gi thuolo mar timo nonro e wi weche modok korka kompyuta, weche ma ok kare, weche ma inyalo konyorego, kod kuonde ma inyalo timoe backup.
Ng'ato nyalo bedo gi paro mar Minecraft ma ok nyal rumo. Mano ok en tong' ma piny duto oketo ne ng'ato ka ng'ato e tuke duto.
Nonro mar mwandu ok nyal miyo jorit obed e sanduk mar CPU/RAM kata miyo ng'ato geno ni Windows ok nyal tieko mwandune. Ti gi ranyisi mar resource monitor kod dashboard mar kompyuteri mondo ing'e kaka ibiro ting'o gik moko.
Jarit mar Intanet Chenro mar chiwo siem e yor thieth mar network-warning fwenyore e yo maok nyalre kuom alwora mar bandwidth/resource kendo oketo ranyisi mar gima SteamCMD ong'ere timo mondo oketh siem mag miriambo.
Ok en ohinga mar geng'o tuoche, kata tiyo gi yore mag manyo yore mag wuoth, kata tiyo gi yore mag kedo gi DDoS. Kata kamano, siemno ok nyiswa ng'at ma ne omonjowa kata ni ne otimnwa gimoro marach.
Sama inyiso ng'ato ni itimo kamano, inyalo pimo tijno gi weche ma ji ong'eyo ni itimo, kod gik mamoko. Non weche motudore gi wechego kapok iloko kuonde mitimoe gik moko e yor sirkal kata e Intanet.

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Yier profil mar Rust kendo ine piny, kit ng'ato, yore mitimogo tuke, penjo, kod gik mamoko motudore kode kapok ichako.
NG'ANO mar JATIM Synix chiwo nengo mar +server.identity mochung' motegno kowuok e kit server. Ket kuonde mopogore opogore koda kido mopogore opogore mondo okonygi kik gipogore e piny kata e yo moro amora.
RUST+ Ket chenro mar tiyo gi App Port e yo makende, kae to iluw chike mag Rust. Oketo tong' mar ng'ato ka ng'ato mondo oket pache e weche mag loyo mich kuom hawi kendo onyalo tiyo gi weche mag RCON.
Tem ane nono kuonde ma idhiye kar ndiko chik moro moa e server machielo mar Rust. Rit weche mag RCON kendo kik ipoggi mondo ikony ji oriwre kodgi.
VANILLA kod OXIDE Vanilla tiyo gi masinde mag server. Ka iyiero Oxide, inyalo medo chenro mar ofis ma itiyogo bang' weche mag Steam. Chenro mar keto chenro ok yier kata nono plugins.
Ti gi mod & Plugin Manager's supportive local workflow e loso oksid/uMod. Pod dwarore ni plugins obed gi loko mowinjore kod kuonde minyalo genie.
Synix tiyo kendo gi thuolo mar tiyo gi Oxide ma itiyogo bang' ka Rust oseloso kata oseng'ado mar tiyo kode, sama oyiero chenro mar tichno. Mondo idog e fail mar Vanilla, lok yier mar chenro kendo iti gi yo mar Update kata Validate.
Kapok itimo lokruok e chenro moro kata e tuke, rit piny, chenro, kod weche mag plugin. Non weche mag tuke kod mag Oxide bang' chako kendo; ka ng'ato ogolo chenro maber, mano ok nyis ni plugin moro amora ne ogol e yo makare.
